Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

</details>


### [111] [When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00372)
*Shuyao Xiao,Shengling Wang,Xuan Chen,Ke Chao,Ming Cui,Feifei Qian,Chaoyang Mei,Fanlin Meng,Ziming Yu,Junxi Yin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文将大语言模型智能体的错误恢复建模为因果决策问题，提出因果干预路由器CIR，在长时程任务中按需选择性干预以提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体恢复机制通常仅以平均任务成功率来评估，掩盖了恢复的双面性：同一恢复操作可能挽救失败轨迹，也可能破坏原本成功的轨迹，因此需要区分恢复的收益与损害。

Method: 从相同执行状态出发，对比有/无恢复两种情形，将恢复效果分解为挽救与损害，并分析恢复价值随时间的变化；进而提出轻量级策略CIR，利用恢复前可得信息判断何时值得干预。

Result: 在Qwen3-14B上的长时程ALFWorld任务中，CIR将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%，提升3.00个百分点，且对所有观测正确的轨迹不做改动；控制实验表明收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测解释。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了评估恢复效果并选择性应用恢复的实用方法，证明因果视角下的选择性干预优于盲目恢复。

Abstract: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

</details>


### [112] [Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00254)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文刻画了在仅能通过精确线性优化预言机访问可行集的在线凸优化中可达到的遗憾界，给出了无维数的极小极大期望遗憾为 Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究当学习器只能调用线性优化预言机（而非直接访问可行集）时，在线凸优化的最优遗憾是多少，并区分总调用预算 Q 与每轮调用上限 B 的影响。

Method: 学习器每轮先获得内切球与直径约束，必须保持可行性；利用固定体构造将新阶段方向与共享单纯形耦合，迫使有用回复反复付出代价；下界适用于任意随机学习器；上界采用带交错块的计数近似梯度法。

Result: 对于 G-Lipschitz 凸损失、直径 ≤ D、总调用预算 Q、每轮调用上限 B，无维数极小极大期望遗憾为 Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})；特例包括每轮一次调用时的 T^{3/4} 速率，以及达到 √T 遗憾所需的二次总预算。

Conclusion: 该刻画统一了总预算与严格每轮限制两种情形；对于给定光滑度 β，解析构造给出依赖曲率的下界，并确定了使一般刻画保持尖锐的阈值。

Abstract: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

</details>


### [113] [Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00416)
*Timothée Lesort,Alejandra López de Aberasturi Gómez,Tristan Karch,Tom Veniat,Philippe Modard,Karl Tuyls,Ludovic Denoyer*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于1,118个Lichess国际象棋谜题的基准，用于研究冻结大语言模型的自动提示优化（APO），该基准评分廉价且确定、难度适中可调、可更新防污染，并能将解谜增益关联到同域短对局表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能力提升使评估愈发困难：基准易饱和、公开测试集易污染、更难任务需昂贵评分或执行设施。APO需在提示搜索中反复评估，因此亟需一个廉价确定、留有改进空间、随模型演进可更新的基准。

Method: 构建含1,118个Lichess谜题的象棋基准，用于冻结LLM的APO（仅优化提示、不更新权重）。采用精确匹配评分与引擎评估替代走法，提供可调难度且可更新的题目；除孤立测试项成功率外，还将解谜增益与同域短对局rollout关联。在8个目标模型上评估6种APO算法，测量基线强度、优化响应度及提示跨模型与对局迁移性。

Result: 最强评估模型Gemini 3.5 Flash（作为元模型）仅解出约55%谜题；不同方法与模型间出现增益、不变与性能回退；完整研究成本约800美元。

Conclusion: 象棋是适合APO的基准：(i) 有挑战性；(ii) 有区分度；(iii) 可再生，新题降低污染风险且难度可调以保持改进空间；(iv) 可负担。作者发布谜题、优化与评估代码及数据集更新脚本。

Abstract: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

</details>


### [114] [Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00511)
*Yizhi Liu,Balaji Padmanabhan,Siva Viswanathan*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出将认知科学中的“认知行动”概念引入LLM智能体设计，强调智能体应通过获取、转换和探测证据来为决策准备可审计的证据基础（认知脚手架）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体设计偏重搜索与探索，却忽视了决策前证据是否充分、可用和可比较这一前置问题。

Method: 借鉴认知科学中“认知行动”理论，区分三种模式：获取缺失证据、转换现有证据、探测系统以生成揭示性响应，并提出“认知脚手架”概念指代支撑这些行动的界面、工具与环境。

Result: 论文通过概念分析论证了智能体设计需要明确处理“决策就绪证据”的生产机制，而非仅关注任务完成。

Conclusion: 智能体设计必须解决决策就绪证据如何产生的问题，认知脚手架为实现可审计的证据准备提供了设计框架。

Abstract: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

</details>


### [115] [Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00529)
*Julie Krugler Hollek,Michael Zargham,Mala Kumar*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出OB-CAIE方法，通过两个本体明确AI评估的测试范围，平衡人工与自动化并提升可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI评估缺乏科学严谨性，表现为测试覆盖不清、人工与自动化失衡以及评估环境不可复现。

Method: 构建领域特定本体（DSO，定义“测什么”）和评估过程本体（EPO，定义“怎么测”），形成可处理的问题空间，并在特定环节引入人工判断。

Result: OB-CAIE能够明确界定测试内容，支持一个或多个AI评估，并允许在复杂领域中以科学方式融入不可替代的人类反馈。

Conclusion: 该方法的主要优势是可在规范的问题空间内追踪、可视化和分析失败点，从而增强AI评估的科学性与可复现性。

Abstract: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

</details>


### [116] [Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00583)
*Sahan Paliskara,Nattaput Namchittai,Andrew Lampinen*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 研究多用户多智能体协调问题，对比单协调者与多智能体团队在五个前沿模型和四个环境中的表现，发现团队协调失败并识别相关行为及缓解措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体越来越多地代表不同用户共享资源（如代码库、日历、预算），当各智能体目标不同时协调常失败，群体结果可能比单一智能体更差，因此需研究该多用户多智能体场景下的协调问题。

Method: 在五个前沿模型和四个环境（API密钥共享计算预算、诊所共享日历、个人助理共享团购/预订、合并队列共享发布截止时间）的77个场景中，比较服务所有用户的单协调者与每个智能体服务一个用户的团队（有无通信通道），并识别失败行为及环境特定缓解措施。

Result: 团队在所有环境中群体结果均差于协调者：无通信通道时两个环境完全崩溃，有通道时协调开销仍造成显著差距；例如个人助理环境中协调者满足目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍。识别出团队增长时停滞、覆盖彼此操作、捏造声明等行为，并发现有效但环境特定的缓解措施，如团队领导、明确程序指令和平台检查（提交前阅读同伴消息）。

Conclusion: 多用户多智能体协调存在系统性缺陷，团队表现普遍不如单一协调者，需针对环境采取特定缓解措施。将发布MAMUBench，包含74个场景用于评估多用户多智能体协调。

Abstract: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

</details>


### [117] [Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00346)
*Amir Rafe,Subasish Das*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 在匹配条件下比较类型化决策模型（System One）、监督分类器与生成式语言模型的决策门控性能，发现模型类别优劣随标签可用性等条件变化，并给出条件依赖的设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件将分支决策交给模型时，需要可声明选项及其可阈值化概率；类型化决策模型能直接返回概率而不生成文本，但监督分类器与生成式语言模型是既有替代方案，需在相同条件下系统比较。

Method: 用同一测试框架向6个家族的8个决策模型检查点（含托管模型Jev）及2个生成式对比模型发送相同语义请求，并在相同工作流、意图与社会科学项目上评分监督与零样本分类器；同时考察选项键似然读取、微调检查点、温度校准、阈值及是/否交换等设置。

Result: 有任务标签时小训练分类器在意图上最准，在工作流上与最佳决策模型无显著差异；无标签时除编码器检查点外所有决策模型在工作流和意图上均超过零样本蕴含分类器；较大生成模型在选项键似然读取下与Jev持平且5%风险下接受更多工作流决策，微调决策检查点提升意图准确率；少选项拟合温度在多选项时增加校准误差，5%范围内风险阈值下Jev仍接受0.310的域外请求，交换是/否使Jev每百答案翻转50.5次。

Conclusion: 结果为自动化决策门控提供条件依赖的设计规则，如意图训练的一级阶段升级到Jev可在全GPU利用率下以0.43成本达到其准确率。

Abstract: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

</details>


### [118] [Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01385)
*Vedrana Krivokuća Hahn,Jérémy Maceiras,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该工作探究在PolyProtect人脸模板保护中，使用系统特定密钥（所有主体共用同一C和E参数）能否生成不可逆的保护模板，以支持在保护域内进行身份去重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PolyProtect采用主体特定密钥（每人独立C和E），虽满足不可链接性，但无法进行身份去重；若改用系统特定密钥，则可能实现去重，但需验证其保护模板是否仍不可逆。

Method: 通过实验（提供开源代码可复现）测试三种系统特定密钥选取方式：(i)从预选的主体特定密钥中选取；(ii)对随机向量应用已有密钥选择算法；(iii)近似拟合一个“好”的C/E对分布来构造系统密钥。

Result: 实验证明上述三种方式均能生成不可逆的PolyProtected模板，且不会降低模板保护潜力。

Conclusion: PolyProtect可在系统特定密钥场景下安全运行，从而为在PolyProtected域内实现身份去重提供了可能性。

Abstract: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.

</details>


### [119] [When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00654)
*Merieme Askour,Ayoub Merimi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 生成式AI使个性化能够即时提供情境信息，但情境并非越多越好。本文提出情境充分性理论，并通过实验验证相关情境提升适宜性，而无关情境则降低并破坏稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统个性化依赖客户证据（历史行为与偏好），而生成式AI允许提供商在响应时提供变化的情境信息，无需预先编码所有条件。这种灵活性带来新问题：情境易于提供时，数量多未必有益。

Method: 提出情境充分性理论，区分不足、充分、饱和与干扰四种状态，并引入情境充分性前沿以定位最小相关集。在一家大型家居零售商的生成式推荐系统上进行全因子实验。

Result: 相关情境提高了推荐适宜性；无关情境降低了适宜性，并导致检索不稳定。

Conclusion: 该框架将个性化从提供更多情境转向识别当前交互实际所需，并在服务过程中实施约束。

Abstract: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

</details>


### [120] [Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00365)
*Jinho Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出ZeNOVA，一种无梯度的初始噪声对齐方法，通过退火软值引导、流形约束超球朗之万动力学和Metropolis-Hastings跳跃，在黑盒奖励场景下稳定高效地优化高斯噪声以提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有初始噪声优化方法多依赖一阶梯度信息，在黑盒奖励场景下不适用或存在不稳定、低效问题。

Method: ZeNOVA采用无梯度方式，结合退火软值引导、流形约束超球朗之万动力学和Metropolis-Hastings跳跃，直接优化高斯分布初始噪声。

Result: 在图像和视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，ZeNOVA优于所有评估的零阶基线，能更稳定地将初始噪声优化至高奖励，并利用高斯先验几何。

Conclusion: ZeNOVA证明了其在实际黑盒奖励对齐中的适用性，为无梯度初始噪声优化提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

</details>


### [121] [A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00668)
*Thorsten Engesser,Agata Ciabattoni*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的信念道义逻辑，用于自主系统在规范冲突和信息不完整不可靠下进行决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统在规范冲突且信息不完整或不可靠时仍需决策，现有逻辑难以同时处理关于事实和规范的信念以及条件规范。

Method: 构造一个信念道义逻辑：Chellas最小道义逻辑的可经典归约片段，扩展显式条件规范，并与多智能体KD45结合；在其上定义信念规范合规优化问题，区分主观优化（相对于智能体信念）与客观优化（相对于实际事实）。

Result: 给出了主观与客观优化一致的条件，以及将最优决策归约为加权部分MaxSAT并在多项式时间内求解的条件。

Conclusion: 该逻辑框架为信念依赖的道义推理和规范合规决策提供了可计算的基础。

Abstract: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

</details>


### [122] [Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00834)
*Wensen Wu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出开源评测框架Kepler，通过可执行世界模型与双重验证机制，在ARC-AGI-3公开游戏集上以固定配置实现满分，并揭示评测失效问题与报告规范建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3要求智能体从交互观察中推断环境规则与目标，现有评测仅关注公开集得分，缺乏对首次尝试、成本与验证过程的区分性报告，难以真实反映智能体能力。

Method: Kepler将假设表示为可执行世界模型，并通过回溯性转移检查与条件预测检查进行验证；采用冻结的Claude Opus 5配置，无逐游戏模型选择或分数条件重跑。

Result: 在25个公开游戏上获得服务器验证的100.00 RHAE；183个完成关卡中181个最终尝试动作数不超过人类中位数基线；保留运行使用8256次环境动作、8.58亿token、97.37%缓存读取、成本777.72美元；报告三类评测失效（源代码泄漏、控制条件下重建框架、自主修复掩盖规划器故障）；单游戏案例显示动画帧含任务相关信息；最终两个模型50个游戏-模型单元中48个达100。

Conclusion: 公开集得分本身区分性有限，应推动首次尝试、成本条件化与验证感知的评测报告规范。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

</details>


### [123] [Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01907)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文发现OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器存在系统性伪影，并给出基于精确有理算术的修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私实现依赖噪声分布的精确采样以保证形式化隐私，OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器的采样质量至关重要。

Method: 通过系统测试，定位输出分布中的周期性失真，追溯到bernoulli_exp1函数所用有理算术库的故障实现；提出诊断方法隔离嵌套采样层级中的故障组件，并设计精确有理算术替代实现。

Result: 10^6样本统计验证表明，修正后的采样器输出在测试精度下与理论分布不可区分。

Conclusion: OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器的伪影源于有理算术库的底层故障，精确有理算术实现可消除伪影并恢复采样正确性。

Abstract: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

</details>


### [124] [WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00398)
*Felix Oury,Harley Day,Karina Mayoral,Ville-Pekka Seppä,Sejal Saglani,Reiko J. Tanaka*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出WIPSNet，一种基于3D ResNet和连续小波变换尺度图的模型，用于夜间阻抗气胸描记的喘息分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床指标EVI将整夜阻抗气胸描记压缩为单一标量，喘息分类AUC仅0.633，需要更有效的表示方法。

Method: WIPSNet对夜间阻抗气胸描记信号堆叠连续小波变换尺度图，使用3D ResNet进行建模。

Result: 在15名患者（60夜，281小时）队列上，WIPSNet达到AUC 0.783±0.026，优于EVI、状态空间模型Mamba和两种现代睡眠分期架构；性能在对应32分钟时间上下文的体积深度达到峰值。

Conclusion: 结构化时频表示结合3D卷积架构能有效学习长时、不规则生理时间序列，多尺度时间聚合对建模夜间呼吸动力学很重要。

Abstract: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

</details>


### [125] [Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01006)
*Sharath M Shankaranarayana,Davor Runje,Jan Jannink*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文审计决策模型Jev的置信度是否能区分“偶然低置信”与“知识缺失”，发现其置信度在熟悉封闭任务上校准良好，但在缺失知识时失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型返回的概率常用于路由、弃权和自动动作。校准仅保证平均意义上有用，无法判断低置信度是源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法判断模型超出知识边界时置信度是否下降。

Method: 在Jev决策模型上，使用超过15个公开数据集和6个生成任务族进行审计；采用配对干预，对固定条目改变所提供的信息；并设计针对性是/否问题，分别探测结果是否确定、证据是否充分、以及模型是否知道答案。

Result: Jev置信度在熟悉的封闭选择任务上校准良好，但不能指示知识缺失：无答案相关信息时对显著选项赋高达0.80的置信度；对超出观察知识边界的新闻，置信度超过准确率0.21–0.33，且用早期月份重校准无法弥合。是/否问题给出更清晰读数：判断结果是否确定AUROC为1.00，判断证据是否充分为0.95（同条目置信度为0.85）；询问模型是否知道答案可标记虚构实体和边界后新闻（0.91），但使用真实姓名或移除日期后，相比答案不确定性无优势。

Conclusion: 黑盒知识审计需要显式控制表面线索；仅依赖答案置信度不足以可靠检测知识缺失。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

</details>


### [126] [Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01045)
*Jiaqi Tang,Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文提出“空承诺”概念，指智能体在当前回合后承诺未来行动，但其工具或运行时无法执行，并给出定义、失败类型与测量方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人常承诺“明天提醒你”却无法自行运行，这类空承诺不同于失信，仅由智能体配置决定，需形式化定义与测量。

Method: 基于承诺语义定义空承诺，包括三种失败类型、工具可实现承诺的锚定条件及响应级结果分类；提出测量协议：在五种逐步添加持久性能力的设置中执行后续请求，环境状态或隐式或明示。

Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，仅描述定义与测量协议。

Conclusion: 空承诺可由智能体配置单独判定，无需后续轨迹；该定义与协议为评估和诊断此类问题提供基础。

Abstract: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

</details>


### [127] [One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00445)
*Zahra Khodagholi,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文提出可微分标量平衡层来建模有限向导负载RISC池的守恒，并证明在单一构建和剂量下排名不变，进而审计剂量和跨上下文实验，发现数据不足以识别竞争参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立解释成对向导-转录本得分作为占据率时，无法强制有限向导负载RISC池的守恒。

Method: 构建一个可微分标量平衡层：包含唯一正根的守恒方程和精确隐式梯度，并推导重分布定理、高资源极限、检索近似分析及条件排名不变性；在档案脱靶数据上审计剂量和跨上下文实验，使用配对置换检验和构建簇自助法。

Result: 校正热力学亲和力与测量抑制弱相关，但耦合未显示附加预测价值；剂量拟合异质且常违反模型隐含的超线性指数约束，数据无法识别竞争参数；可饱和压缩在留出向导家族上保持精度但未更快。

Conclusion: 贡献是可复用的守恒算子和测试所需的实验信息，代码见GitHub。

Abstract: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

</details>


### [128] [Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01048)
*Rishab Alagharu,Hongji Pu,Zeeshan Memon,Xinyuan Song,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种动作条件网络世界模型，学习网络扩散动态，作为快速评估器嵌入由编码智能体驱动的算法设计循环，在八项网络任务和五种扩散模型上多数设置优于最强基线并大幅加速 rollout。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统中动作效果非即时显现（如播种节点、免疫节点），需评估后续多步累积结果；候选动作评分依赖仿真，在多轨迹采样下成本成为瓶颈。

Method: 构建动作条件 Network World Model：学习干预下网络随时间的扩散动态，对网络施加动作并预测后续结果；将其作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环，编码智能体依据完整 rollout、动作级信度与替代干预的反事实探测反馈来设计并迭代可执行算法。

Result: 在 8 项网络任务与 5 种扩散模型的 141 个设置中，所设计算法在 138 个设置上达到或超过已报告最强基线；rollout 速度相比蒙特卡洛仿真最高提升 14.5 倍。

Conclusion: 以学习到的世界模型替代高成本仿真，可为网络干预类算法设计提供高效评估与迭代闭环，兼顾性能与效率，代码将于录用后发布。

Abstract: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [129] [CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01124)
*Jiazhen Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Zihao Ding,Kailong Wang,Yu Wu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出轻量适配器CortexBridge，将任意电极布局的EEG映射到共享皮层潜在空间，提升冻结基础模型在多个BCI数据集上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型通常使用固定通道词汇或有限蒙太奇进行预训练，导致电极布局变化时迁移困难。

Method: CortexBridge结合EEG特征与电极和地图集坐标，将任意蒙太奇映射到共享皮层潜在空间；在MOABB的五个BCI数据集上，用三个冻结基础模型进行评估。

Result: 在15项评估中13项性能提升；平衡准确率平均提升：EEGPT 0.80%，LaBraM 0.70%，CBraMod 3.26%，最大提升13.02%（12类SSVEP分类）；可视化显示任务依赖的空间模式，SSVEP在Yeo视觉网络比听觉P300更集中。

Conclusion: 皮层对齐是一种可学习且解剖学基础的机制，能将异质EEG蒙太奇路由到预训练基础模型。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

</details>


### [130] [SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00523)
*Liang You,Hengyu Shi,Dongwen Ou*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: SimplexUQ是首个针对单纯形值预测的共形预测覆盖率分配问题的基准与可复现协议，通过12个任务比较现有共形包装器，发现全局校准可能掩盖分层覆盖不均且无包装器普遍占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测仅保证边际覆盖率，单一校准阈值会导致覆盖率在易/难区域分布不均（过覆盖易区域、欠覆盖难区域），但缺乏针对单纯形值预测的标准化评估协议。

Method: 构建SimplexUQ基准与SimplexTasks-12任务套件（6个受控合成机制+6个冻结预测器的真实任务，涵盖类概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布、情感混合）；每次比较固定预测器、评分和响应无关分层图，仅改变包装器，报告边际覆盖率、最差分层覆盖率、最大差异、任务内半径和计算量。

Result: 全局校准看似有效但分层失败：CIFAR-10边际覆盖率0.900，最差熵分层仅0.542；Mondrian校准将该分层提升至0.886，最大差异从0.358降至0.022。无包装器普遍占优：平滑合成异质性下多种修复方法竞争性相当；固定图分析显示排名依赖评估组和协议；12任务比较中Mondrian在其单一目标分区上12个任务差异更低，而BatchMVP在重叠组上5个任务差异更低。预测器偏差扫描表明去除偏差仅部分减少全局阈值差异。

Conclusion: SimplexUQ提供经验性比较而非新覆盖保证，将包装器选择视为诊断比较而非通用排名，并发布任务卡、结果溯源、允许的派生数组和重建指令。

Abstract: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

</details>


### [131] [Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01138)
*Haotian Chen,Bowen Ye,Yuning Zhang,Jingkun Yu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM智能体环境中并发动作的仲裁问题，提出类型化快照结算合约，并审计顺序敏感性、有效进展和重放一致性三个属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使每个动作提议单独有效，并发动作也需要仲裁机制；现有方法在顺序不变性、进展效率和可重放性方面缺乏系统评估。

Method: 实现类型化快照结算合约，测试五种结算策略，在28,800次穷举排列试验和2,160次脚本化多步回合中进行评估，并单独进行全状态日志审计。

Result: 联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变；保守拒绝策略在六智能体门口任务中仅完成31.25%，而随机票据达90.28%，配对改进59.03个百分点（95% bootstrap区间：50.00-68.06）；所有策略保持空间约束；优先级仲裁仍错过独立小实例最优；全状态日志审计精确重放156个检查点并拒绝1,332个构造损坏，保留终端锚点。

Conclusion: 证据涉及执行语义，而非人类真实性或长期公平性；类型化快照结算合约可有效审计并发仲裁属性，但保守拒绝策略进展效率低，优先级仲裁非最优。

Abstract: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

</details>


### [132] [When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01188)
*Haotian Chen,Jingkun Yu,Yuning Zhang,Bowen Ye*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究审计REHAB24-6数据中的1,057次动作重复，检验基于关节选择的骨架动作正确性分类增益，强调评估聚合、子集结构与时间表示对结论的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究表明特定关节选择可提升基于骨架的动作正确性分类，但该增益的统计意义与稳健性尚不明确。

Method: 对10名受试者的1,057次重复进行探索性审计，比较池化交叉验证AUROC与等权个体内AUROC两种估计量，并构建1,000个维度匹配随机映射作为对照，同时匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入；此外比较RBF-SVM、逻辑回归和随机卷积比较器，并执行序列顺序与配对种子控制。

Result: 手动子集kNN增益从池化AUROC的0.055降至个体内AUROC的0.020，且配对区间均包含零；在1,000个随机映射中，14个达到或超过手动池化结果，匹配双侧与躯干结构后增至145个；RBF-SVM在个体内估计量下保持正增益，而逻辑回归和随机卷积比较器为负点增益。

Conclusion: 该探索性审计表明关节选择声明必须明确估计量并使用结构适当的对照，但未建立新算法或临床获益。

Abstract: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

</details>


### [133] [Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01262)
*Lili Chen,Gavin Buskes,Yuxin Ren,Chin Tong Leong*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在自我导向练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分转移到对解答的前期验证，以解决反馈即时性与可信度之间的张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型电气工程班级学生与助教比例高，学生遇到问题可能等待数天才能获得反馈，而反馈的即时性和针对性对学习影响很大。生成式AI可扩展对话式反馈，但用于评分会引发信任和问责问题，保留人工监督又会导致反馈延迟，形成即时性与可信度之间的张力。

Method: 设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在自我导向练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，并将人工监督重新定位到对解答的前期验证，而非实时评分。

Result: 研究旨在了解学生如何与该工具互动、如何感知其反馈的价值和可靠性，以及哪些经验可迁移到其他工程学科；摘要未报告具体结果数据。

Conclusion: 通过将人工监督从实时评分转移到前期验证，可在实践中缓解反馈即时性与可信度之间的张力，并为其他工程学科提供可迁移的经验。

Abstract: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

</details>


### [134] [Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00615)
*Andy Arditi,Weian Xie,David Bau,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 深度线性残差网络学习恒等映射时，SGD在总体损失相同的解流形中偏好特定分解，该现象可由熵损失（梯度范数平方期望）解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究SGD为何在众多等价于恒等映射的解中偏好特定解，以及参数化改变为何影响解的选择。

Method: 分析恒等映射解流形，引入熵损失（总体损失加梯度平方范数期望），解析刻画极小值点，并与SGD训练结果比较。

Result: 各向异性标签噪声下学到的层呈现噪声依赖谱；SGD一般不收敛到零权重解，但矩阵分解参数化下权重收敛到零；SGD结果与熵损失预测吻合。

Conclusion: 恒等学习任务表明熵损失能解释SGD为何偏好同一输入输出函数的不同分解。

Abstract: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

</details>


### [135] [Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01282)
*Antonio Emanuele Cinà,Giovanni Scodeller,Cecilia Caterina Pasquale,Silvia Siri,Davide Anguita,Fabio Roli,Simona Sacone,Luca Oneto*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文综述了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信数据与机器学习运维（DataOps和MLOps）的重要性、关键组件、工具、案例及可信AI方法，并指出了当前文献空白与未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ITS&L的快速发展依赖数据、AI和ML的集成，但当前文献缺乏对可信DataOps和MLOps在ITS&L中系统性综述，亟需填补这一空白。

Method: 通过文献综述方法，识别现有研究缺口，系统讨论DataOps和MLOps的必要性、关键组件、可用工具、实践见解与案例研究，并分析增强AI系统可信度的方法与工具。

Result: 综述了DataOps和MLOps在ITS&L中的复杂性、工具及实际应用，探讨了可信AI在真实场景中的实现方法，并总结了持续挑战与未来前景。

Conclusion: 本工作为ITS&L中DataOps和MLOps建立了基础理解，并为开发更高效、可持续和可信的智能交通与物流系统指明了进一步研究与创新方向，可作为研究人员、从业者和政策制定者的重要资源。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

</details>


### [136] [Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00637)
*Xiaomian Yang,Sungho Shin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文为指数稳定系统的向量自回归模型在重尾噪声下的最小二乘估计建立了非渐近样本复杂度界，并推广至次指数与次高斯噪声及带外生输入的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最小二乘估计的样本复杂度分析多针对轻尾噪声或渐近情形，缺乏对重尾噪声下基于单条轨迹的非渐近保证，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 假设噪声独立同分布、噪声协方差有界且满足持续激励条件，在噪声具有有界p阶矩（p>2）下推导估计误差界；提出统一的分析框架以适配不同噪声分布，并特化至带外生输入的自回归模型。

Result: 估计误差为Õ(r^{1/2} T^{-1/2+1/p})，其中T为样本数、r为噪声维度；次指数与次高斯噪声的误差界可由统一框架导出；在带外生输入的模型中，误差界的维度因子与模型阶数无关。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了重尾噪声下VAR模型最小二乘估计的非渐近样本复杂度界，统一了多类噪声分布的分析，并揭示了带外生输入情形下维度因子与模型阶数解耦的特性。

Abstract: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

</details>


### [137] [Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00647)
*Liam Storan,Andreas Tolias,Nina Miolane*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文证明，当词共现统计对某个群G不变时，语言模型学到的词嵌入由G的不可约表示矩阵元构成，从而统一解释月份循环、和弦五度圈及天体球谐嵌入等几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究发现语言模型对月份、星期等概念的表示呈现圆环或鞍形流形，并将其归因于共现统计的平移对称性；本文旨在将这一解释推广到更一般的对称性，以统一多种观察到的表示几何。

Method: 考虑由任意有限群、紧群和齐性空间定义的对称性，证明若某词族的共现统计在群G下不变，则学到的词嵌入由G的不可约表示的矩阵元组成；并在三个实验场景中验证该不可约表示结构。

Result: 在Z12循环群下复现了月份的圆形几何；在二面体群作用于大小三和弦时，统一了音乐理论中移位与转位构成T/I群与机器学习中五度圈的出现；并解释和复现了LLM中天体对象的球谐表示。

Conclusion: 学习表示的几何往往是底层数据统计对称性的结果，对称性为理解语言模型概念表示提供了统一的理论框架。

Abstract: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

</details>


### [138] [Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01297)
*Achal Nanjundamurthy,Rupam Misra,Suzanne Little,Alan F. Smeaton*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种无标签电力负荷分解系统，通过事件检测与问卷引导估计，将30分钟智能电表数据分解为9类电器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表数据分辨率仅30分钟，无法反映家用电器用电细节，而现有分解方法通常需要标签或更高频数据。

Method: 结合高功率负荷的事件检测与问卷调查引导估计，形成混合分解方法，在四个数据集上进行评估（校准家庭、UK-DALE、REFIT、2968户爱尔兰消费者智能电表数据）。

Result: 在所有数据集的建筑上整体分解误差最低，在54个配对月份中月级性能更优（p<0.001，Holm校正），优于两个独立开发的分解系统。

Conclusion: 该方法能提供有用的家庭能耗模式建议，并针对部分电器给出降低或转移用电以节省成本的建议。

Abstract: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

</details>


### [139] [DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01306)
*Stephanie Finley,Liudas Panavas,Thomas Mikkelson,Cam Hinton,Stacey Ganss,Bradley Monton,Emily Kendall,Michelle Spradlin,Lydia Bye,Michael O'Brien,Lauren Ylvisaker,Derek Ray,Suhaas Garre,Sushant Mehta,Edwin Chen*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文提出DAYJOB基准，包含医疗和金融领域的130个专业工作任务，用于评估智能体在真实专业场景中的端到端任务完成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多考察孤立技能，而专业工作常始于模糊请求，需专业人员自行推断需求、识别关键文档并验证前提是否成立，这种能力缺乏评估手段。

Method: 构建130个容器化Harbor环境任务（医疗50、金融80），每项配备专家设计的二元标准评分表（每题中位数47.5与57.5条），由智能体评判员对交付文件逐条核验，全部满足方算通过；测试13家开发者的30种模型配置。

Result: 最强模型Claude Opus 5.5在医疗和金融任务上的通过率分别为24.7%和23.9%，中位配置仅0.6%和2.5%；案例显示智能体会接受与记录矛盾的前提，并在后续一致分析中沿用错误输入。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在真实专业任务上表现仍十分有限，DAYJOB为评估端到端专业能力提供了严格基准，并公开医疗任务、50项金融任务、评估工具与排行榜。

Abstract: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

</details>


### [140] [An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01326)
*Aldo Gangemi,Rita T. Sousa,Luigi Asprino,Giorgia Lodi,Andrea G. Nuzzolese,Valentina Presutti,Johannes Gysen,Diana F. Sousa,Luigi Spagnolo*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出欧洲危机管理本体ECMO，一个模块化OWL本体，用于灾害风险减少与响应的跨领域参考，并通过流行病新闻知识图谱构建验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害风险减少与响应领域缺乏跨领域、统一的正式知识表示参考模型，导致知识表示与集成不一致。

Method: ECMO设计为模块化本体网络：ECMO-CORE捕获危害、事件、暴露、影响、响应措施等核心概念，使用本体设计模式与OWL2 punning技术解决危害类型与事件表现间的歧义；领域模块如公共卫生模块对齐SNOMED CT和ICD-11。利用ECMO表示联合研究中心的Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources系统数据，构建从非结构化流行病新闻到ECMO兼容知识图谱的端到端流水线。

Result: 初步结果表明，ECMO为一致且统一的知识表示与集成提供了必要的正式约束。

Conclusion: ECMO可作为灾害风险减少与响应领域的跨领域参考本体，支持知识表示与集成，本体已公开并以CC BY 4.0许可发布。

Abstract: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

</details>


### [141] [Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00707)
*Mansi Sakarvadia,Marco Ciccone,Colin Raffel*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 研究LLM驱动发现中迭代种群与发现成功率的关系，提出并行探索初始化干预方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动发现依赖迭代优化，但发现成功率脆弱且对harness设计敏感，需要探究种群多样性与最终成功的关系。

Method: 泛化harness设计，构建12种'Modular'harness，在5个多样化发现任务上评估性能；识别模式崩溃现象；提出早期并行探索初始化后续迭代优化的通用干预。

Result: 发现成功率脆弱且对harness设计敏感；模式崩溃是常见失败模式；现有最先进harness和多样性干预效果不一致；早期发现性能可预测最终成功；所提方法在多种harness和应用上获得一致增益。

Conclusion: 初始化在LLM驱动发现中至关重要，并行探索初始化能稳定提升发现成功率。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

</details>


### [142] [WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00713)
*Dominik Matuszek,Bartosz Zieliński,Tomasz Danel,Dawid Rymarczyk*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文提出了WOMBAT基准，用于评估GNN解释器的归因准确性，通过手工设置消息传递权重构建14个已知决策规则的GNN模型，发现Integrated Gradients等方法在特定模型上会产生错误归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN解释器产生的意外归因无法区分是解释器失败还是模型学到了捷径，缺乏归因真实标签来识别和解释解释器错误。

Method: 构建WOMBAT基准，包含14个白盒GNN，每个模型的消息传递权重手工设置以检测特定SMARTS基序，决策规则已知，从而提供归因真实标签；在数百万PubChem分子上验证，评估GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients等事后解释器。

Result: 定性分析指导构建了一个模型，使Integrated Gradients将归因分散到整个图上，尽管模型可靠地检测到目标基序；验证了模型在大量分子上的表现，并识别了解释器错误。

Conclusion: 发布数据集、模型和评估代码，以帮助研究人员开发新的GNN可解释AI工具。

Abstract: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.

</details>


### [143] [Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01403)
*Xiaoli Liu,Malu Zhang,Yang Yang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文通过多尺度频谱分析发现脉冲神经元和脉冲自注意力（SSA）具有低通滤波特性，导致高频信息耗散，从而造成脉冲Transformer与ANN的性能差距；为此提出脉冲对比注意力（SCA）范式，通过全局对比聚合提取对比原型并进行局部差分细化，有效增强高频信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲Transformer结合了SNN的能效与自注意力的表示能力，但与ANN对应模型相比仍存在性能差距。先前工作多归因于二值激活，本文旨在揭示真正原因并提出改进方案。

Method: 采用多尺度频谱分析证明脉冲神经元和SSA均为低通滤波器；受生物视觉系统边缘检测和差分感知特性启发，设计SCA模块，包含全局对比聚合（提取对比原型）和局部差分细化（增强高频信息）两个步骤。

Result: 在图像分类、语义分割和基于事件的跟踪任务上，SCA作为通用模块持续提升脉冲Transformer性能；同时相比原始SSA具有更低复杂度和更优效率。

Conclusion: SCA可作为节能脉冲Transformer的基础构建模块，具有广泛应用潜力。

Abstract: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extensive experiments show that SCA is a general module that consistently boosts Spiking Transformers across image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking. Furthermore, it achieves lower complexity, offering superior efficiency over original SSA. These results establish its potential as a fundamental building block for energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.

</details>


### [144] [NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01461)
*Zhaoxu Meng,Yiming Sun,Mingyuan Gao,Jiachang Zhang,Zhuhan Dai,Yipeng Du,Zheng Lian,Jian-Qiao Zhu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个约800小时的第一人称个人行为数据集NextMe-800，以及开放词汇K步序列预测基准NextAct，用于研究个性化行为预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们常计划宏大但行动惯性，事后希望能在决策时模拟后见之明；若系统能基于个人历史生成可能轨迹，或可帮助制定更现实计划和更明智决策。

Method: 从一名志愿者126天收集约800小时第一人称数据（1 Hz图像、注视、音频），按五个层级抽象（从原子动作到主要活动）加标题；将个性化动作预测形式化为开放词汇K步序列预测，构建NextAct基准（结合NextMe-800与多人EgoLife数据集），使用基于嵌入的软编辑距离作为评价指标。

Result: 在不同抽象层级和预测时域上评估了多种模型对个人行为的预测能力。

Conclusion: NextMe-800和NextAct为研究从自我中心观察中能提前多久预测个人行为提供了数月规模的资源和评估框架。

Abstract: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. Using an embedding-based soft edit distance as the metric, we evaluate how well different models can anticipate personal behavior across abstraction levels and prediction horizons. NextMe-800 and NextAct provide a months-long resource and evaluation framework for studying how far ahead personal behavior can be anticipated from egocentric observation.

</details>


### [145] [MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01506)
*Zongrui Yang,Li Xintong,Runchen Xu,Zhongsheng Wang,Zhedong Lin,Haoyuan Li,Jiamou Liu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出MCRI四维框架及基于大模型的MCRI-Eval技能评估方法，并在大规模技能数据与多基准执行中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体从单工具系统向模块化、复合架构演进，技能成为能力开发与分发的重要机制，但学术界缺乏对技能进行系统分析与评估的结构化框架。

Method: 基于信息增益与行为约束提出四维MCRI框架，并将其操作化为基于大语言模型的评估方法MCRI-Eval；使用OpenClaw技能库的63,812个公开技能，在BigCodeBench、BFCL-Fundamental和Mind2Web上进行58,275次技能条件模型执行。

Result: MCRI-Eval得分与社区流行度信号正相关，在下游排序一致性上优于所评估方法；在三个基准上提升top-1技能选择，相比各基准最强基线，所选技能下游性能排名分别提升17.7、22.8和19.6个百分点。

Conclusion: MCRI-Eval可为高成本执行评估前的技能优先级排序提供有用的预执行信号。

Abstract: As agents evolve from single-tool systems into modular, composite architectures, skills are becoming an important mechanism for capability development and distribution. However, the academic community lacks a structured framework for systematically analyzing and evaluating skills. Drawing on information gain and behavioral constraint, we propose the four-dimensional MCRI Framework and operationalize it as MCRI-Eval, a large language model-based evaluation method. We evaluate MCRI-Eval using 63,812 public skills from the OpenClaw skill Hub, with 58,275 skill-conditioned model executions across BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web. MCRI-Eval scores are positively associated with community popularity signals and achieve the highest downstream ranking agreement among the evaluated methods. MCRI-Eval also improves top-1 skill selection across all three benchmarks: compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, the skills selected by MCRI-Eval advance by 17.7, 22.8, and 19.6 percentile points in downstream performance rank on BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web, respectively. These results indicate that MCRI-Eval provides a useful pre-execution signal for prioritizing promising skills before costly execution-based evaluation.

</details>


### [146] [Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00818)
*Ayesha Tanveer,Khandakar Ahmed,Assefa Teshome,Oyetunde Gbadeyan,Ziad Nehme*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 基于澳大利亚维多利亚州2020年1月至2024年3月的285万次救护车出勤数据，量化了全州急救反应中“救护车滞留”的规模、趋势与运营相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 救护车滞留是急救服务中的关键运营瓶颈，但其系统性规模和动态在大范围内尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 采用探索性数据分析，对202万次急诊转运记录（覆盖59家医院和79个地方政府区域）进行区间分解、帕累托集中度、小时互相关、医院到达并发性和优先级分层运营比较。

Result: 累计救护车损失时长1,491,127小时，相当于每天损失约96个十小时班次；59家医院中10家贡献57.8%的损失时长（来自50.9%的病例）；年度损失上升57%至2022年峰值，而转运需求下降3.7%；交接时长随前一小时到达同一医院的救护车数量单调增加，且该效应在一天各时段均存在；小时需求与2-4小时后的滞留中度相关（r=0.365）。

Conclusion: 研究结果为医院状态感知的救护车路径规划提供了实证前提。

Abstract: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

</details>


### [147] [Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01533)
*Aleksei Medvedev,Alejandro Ariza-Casabona,Steven Derby,Gonzalo Fiz Pontiveros,Xinyang Shao,Florian Spiess*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文将语义ID（SID）构建重新定义为递归聚类问题，提出图信息语义ID（GrIS）统一框架，将SID分配视为分层图划分，并实例化RecDMoN与RQ-GAE，在真实数据上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐的SID构建被视为表示学习问题，但作者认为该视角是偶然的；SID构建本质上是递归聚类问题，且应同时利用内容语义与协同信号，因此需要将图结构纳入聚类对象。

Method: 将SID构建形式化为图上的层次化划分：节点携带语义内容，边携带协同信号。提出GrIS框架，包含两个可配置轴——图构建与递归划分算法；RQ-VAE和RQ-KMeans被证明是图为空时的特例。具体实现两种实例：RecDMoN使用可微图池化进行层次分配；RQ-GAE在RQ-VAE基础上加入图感知物品表示和图重构目标。

Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，GrIS持续优于协同过滤感知的SOTA方法，Hit@10最高提升52%。

Conclusion: GrIS将SID构建统一为递归图聚类框架，使图构建与划分算法成为显式、可独立配置的组件，便于系统评估与组合改进，从而超越既有方法。

Abstract: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

</details>


### [148] [In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00921)
*Oliver Obst,Frieder Stolzenburg*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文将世界模型评分在CEM中的两种作用（当前决策与后续候选分布）分离评估，发现评分误差会同时影响两者，且提议分布随迭代收缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CEM使用世界模型分数选择动作序列并拟合下一轮采样分布，因此评分误差会同时改变当前决策和后续候选。作者希望分别评估评分的这两种角色。

Method: 在Walker和Cheetah任务上，用四种预测模型生成CEM轨迹，并对每个保存的候选池重新评分。在环境中执行相同候选得到参考精英集和提议更新。共12个独立训练的任务-种子单元。

Result: 所有单元中，预设提议距离从首次到最终CEM迭代均下降；提议宽度收缩，拟合均值相对剩余搜索宽度分离。成对排序一致性在Walker接近随机，在Cheetah下降；精英集一致性未改善。Cheetah上评分器间差异大于池来源间差异，Walker两者及其配对均有差异。

Conclusion: 用环境排名替换首个模型排名更新，在用于选择的6个单元及6个留出单元中均降低了最终实际选中序列成本，表明分离评估有助于定位评分误差的影响。

Abstract: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update.
  Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

</details>


### [149] [GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00948)
*Geyi Yang,Zikun Qu,Xiang Li,Zhiyong Wang,Min Zhang,Shipei Zeng,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出GUI-HARVEST，一种针对GUI智能体的自动执行框架优化器，在冻结主干模型下实现自我改进，通过对齐视觉效应、联合多次运行证据和跨任务失败模式到有界代码编辑来优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI模型的可执行框架决定观察、动作与验证控制，但自动优化该框架面临三大耦合挑战：模型意图与视觉效应协调、可变执行结果下的失败诊断、跨任务失败模式识别并转化为可复用运行时修改。

Method: GUI-HARVEST将模型输出与执行动作同前后截图对齐，把同一任务多次运行视为联合证据单元进行任务内比较，并将跨任务验证的失败模式映射为有界源代码编辑，编辑前记录预测，通过重复执行检查预测行为效应与任务性能。

Result: 在OSWorld-Verified上六种主干模型均获留出增益，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct全套提升12.33分；冻结框架迁移使GPT-5在WindowsAgentArena 50步下提升13.87个百分点；相同主干与初始框架下优于Self-Harness和Meta-Harness。

Conclusion: GUI特定诊断与验证有助于框架改进泛化到未见任务，实现无需微调主干模型的自我改进GUI智能体。

Abstract: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences.
