Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

</details>


### [401] [Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00436)
*Hongyu Chen,Xinyi Luo,Ming Zhao,Lin Tang,Zihan Xu,Jing Li,Yuxuan Wang,Haoran Deng,Wei Zhang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文揭示了在线批选择中样本内梯度匹配为何难以超越全批训练，并提出无偏的留一法目标LOOM，通过按梯度的信噪比加权选样，在多任务多模型上实现性能提升与噪声鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线批选择中，基于梯度匹配的选择器无需验证集，但通常无法优于全批训练。作者旨在解释这一现象并找到无需验证集且能超越全批训练的选择方法。

Method: 分析发现样本内梯度匹配的目标函数将每个样本自身梯度噪声计入对角线，导致偏向高噪声样本且全批成为最优解。移除对角线后，利用其他候选样本作为独立样本，得到对总体梯度更新误差的无偏估计，即留一法目标。其最小化解按样本梯度信噪比加权。基于此提出LOOM：在普通反向传播中计算Adam预条件子度量下的Gram矩阵，以(1-e^{-γ})保证贪心选择加权子集，无需验证数据。

Result: 在四个微调任务和七个1.5B至8B参数的主干模型上，LOOM在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上分别比全批训练提升2.3和2.4个点；比所有样本内梯度匹配器高2.4个点，比验证引导的GREATS和OPUS高1.6-2.0个点；对注入标签噪声的选择率低于其基础率的五分之一。

Conclusion: 样本内梯度匹配因协方差惩罚而失效，移除对角线得到的留一法目标无偏且能通过信噪比加权实现更优更新。LOOM作为无需验证集的实用方法，在多种模型和任务上一致超越全批训练及现有选择器，并显著抑制标签噪声。

Abstract: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

</details>


### [402] [Exact information accounting for SGD methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00446)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文从信息论角度精确分析随机梯度下降及其变体，将预条件SGD步解释为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，并将单步遗憾分解为本征时间成本与比较器信息变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统几何分析之外，需要一个统一的信息论框架来理解SGD及其多种变体、收敛性、泛化性以及优化器差异。

Method: 将预条件SGD步视为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，推导单步遗憾分解为内在时间成本与比较器信息变化，并扩展到目标函数恒等式；在合成与真实训练中测量各项，分析梯度自由SGD的曲率预条件器。

Result: 该恒等式涵盖凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦性与泛化联系、标准学习率计划、自适应优化器及噪声、动量、重尾、无梯度等变体；在真实网络上，经典收敛界松弛归因于推导中丢弃的项，并区分达到相同训练损失的优化器，其分离与步数和一致性有关；泛化差异因网络而异；基于锐度的泛化证书在网络规模下除非曲率谱近乎平坦，否则为空。

Conclusion: SGD及其变体可由一个精确的信息论恒等式统一刻画，为优化器行为、收敛界松弛和泛化提供新解释，但现有基于锐度的泛化证书在网络尺度下通常无效。

Abstract: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

</details>


### [403] [YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01097)
*Yoonkyu Woo,Woojin Lee,Jin-Xia Huang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 YouRA 架构，实现有状态、证据可追踪的自主研究，在 MLR-Bench 端到端任务上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端研究代理能生成完整论文，但论文主张常与执行实验不符，根源在于研究状态、失败历史和主张-证据对齐未作为持久可验证状态维护。

Method: YouRA 集成三组件：验证状态架构 VSA（跟踪假设、门控、证据指针）、独立控制器（将状态与反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复与辩论/评审控制，分离控制与执行）、有状态反思（将失败记录为结构化教训，经有界修复、重设计或重置路由恢复）。

Result: 在 MLR-Bench 预定义十任务端到端子集上，YouRA 在三种匹配骨干中均优于 MLR-Agent 和 AI Scientist V2 的 Overall 标量；基于幻觉分类法的自动诊断报告四类事实型失败的交集/并集计数，数据溯源诊断显示更多真实数据输出；消融 VSA、独立控制器、MCP 工具访问、反思引导恢复支持各自独立贡献，移除任一核心状态组件均使性能低于完整系统。

Conclusion: 维护持久、可验证的研究状态与证据追踪能有效提升自主研究代理的端到端表现与可追溯性，各核心组件贡献可分离且必要。

Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

</details>


### [404] [Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00497)
*Yeongmin Kim,Arnaud Doucet,Andrew Campbell,Valentin De Bortoli,Thomas Mensink,David Ruhe*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出Gumbel Straight Flow（GSF），一种连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归语言模型的噪声-数据耦合实现少步高质量文本生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前少步语言生成方法在质量和效率上仍有不足，需要利用预训练自回归模型的先验知识来构建更优的生成路径。

Method: 基于Gumbel噪声与one-hot token序列的耦合，理论证明自回归模型诱导出连接噪声与序列表示的非相交线性路径；采用流映射半群目标，由AR教师直接引导切线（速度）条件，增强少步路径采样质量。

Result: 在预训练和下游任务等多个基准上，GSF超越现有少步语言生成基线。

Conclusion: GSF通过利用AR模型的噪声-数据耦合和流映射半群目标，有效提升了少步语言生成的性能。

Abstract: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

</details>


### [405] [Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01128)
*Aditya Dubey,Namah Gupta,Vinti Agarwal*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究将指令微调的语言模型置于六个Snowdrop支持的DSGE模拟器中，通过多轮交互和强化学习（PPO与GRPO对比）来评估其政策行动是否与经济动态一致，而非仅依赖语言合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型能生成听起来合理的经济政策回应，但这不能证明其行动符合经济动态；需要一种基于模拟经济后果的评估方法。

Method: 在六个DSGE模拟器中嵌入指令微调语言模型，每轮模型观察经济状态和话语变化，选择有界政策行动，接收下一状态和经济奖励；实现通用Python接口支持重复 rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆和滚动视界模拟。比较PPO（带学习价值函数，通过广义优势估计传播延迟奖励）与GRPO（无学习价值函数，使用组相对优势）在长视界信用分配问题上的表现，并测试方向语义信号、奖励视界、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移及历史锚定的疫情和货币政策冲击。

Result: PPO能通过价值函数将延迟奖励传播到早期token，而GRPO因无法区分早期回合的贡献，在回报相同的情况下归一化优势为零，因此PPO作为主要方法，GRPO作为匹配的无评论家基线。

Conclusion: 应依据模拟经济后果而非仅凭合理语言来判断政策行动，PPO在该长视界信用分配任务中优于GRPO。

Abstract: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

</details>


### [406] [Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00564)
*Kailen Hargenrader,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 针对概率测度上的算子学习，当测度具有多项式尾部时，softmax 的指数加权会导致测度级注意力积分发散，因此提出使用增长更慢的注意力核，并通过基准实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: softmax 注意力中的指数加权在多项式尾部分布下会使测度级注意力积分发散，需要更慢增长的函数来替代指数函数。

Method: 构建两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准（矩阵求逆和剪切交换任务），比较 softmax 与三种增长更慢的注意力核在后归一化 transformer 中的注意力核增长和数据变换（如 symlog 预处理）的影响，并分析样本量对经验能量和 Wasserstein 距离尾部敏感性的影响。

Result: 无数据变换时，softmax 模型在两个重尾基准上均出现集成坍缩，而三种慢增长核避免坍缩；symlog 预处理使 softmax 在矩阵求逆任务上避免坍缩，但在剪切交换任务上无效；高斯控制下四种核表现相似。

Conclusion: 慢增长注意力核是后归一化 transformer 从重尾集成中学习的有效设计选择。

Abstract: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

</details>


### [407] [From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00580)
*Hojat Allah Salehi,Mehrdad Mahdavi,Andrew Arash Mahyari,M. Hadi Amini*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 论文研究联邦学习中客户端内部存在未知任务混合的复合异质性问题，提出路由输入到专门专家以提高性能的方法FedSEE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习处理客户端间异质性，但未解决客户端内潜在任务混合问题，即复合异质性（客户端间和客户端内均异质）。

Method: 基于共享冻结表示，在平方损失下证明客户端任务混合的最优模型是底层任务最优模型的凸组合；利用少量任务标注公开样本，通过凸规划恢复任务专家并匹配任务；提出FedSEE，实现输入依赖的专家选择与客户端任务混合对齐。

Result: 实验表明FedSEE避免负迁移，整体性能提升2.9分，服务最差四分之一客户端提升3.7分。

Conclusion: 有效专门化需要输入依赖的专家选择与客户端任务混合对齐，FedSEE通过路由输入到专门专家解决了复合异质性，提升了性能并改善了公平性。

Abstract: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

</details>


### [408] [ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00672)
*Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Ivan Garibay,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，检验ESM-2表征层级中高阶上位性信息的保留程度，但独立重复实验显示原有差异大幅缩小且符号不稳定，因此尚无稳健证据支持ESM-2选择性丢失高阶上位性信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型虽支持突变效应与结构预测，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示模型深度中可获取的生物学相互作用信息形式；作者希望探究ESM-2是否像保留一阶、二阶信息那样强地保留高阶上位性信息。

Method: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，结合基于Walsh的相互作用分解与子集条件神经依赖性估计；先在具有已知相互作用结构的合成适应度景观上验证方法，再使用冻结的ESM-2表征应用于密集四站点GB1适应度景观。

Result: 初始生产运行显示ESM-2对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息（Δ_HO-LO=-0.107）；但在匹配GPU硬件和相同critic种子的完整测量网格独立重复中，该对比大幅缩小（Δ_HO-LO=-0.017），且在同一训练critic上采用其他合理评估配对选择时符号不稳定（-0.011至+0.015）。

Conclusion: 目前没有稳健证据表明ESM-2选择性丢失高阶上位性信息，也不能证明各阶保留程度相等，方向性问题仍开放；测量协议本身（包括去除池化critic中的位置子集捷径）仍经验证且不受该发现影响；ORBIT-FMIB可作为探测蛋白质基础模型相互作用结构的诊断框架，但研究自身的重复结果说明此类探测在将输出视为生物学发现前需进行充分功效的可重复性检验。

Abstract: Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

</details>


### [409] [Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01348)
*Ali Atiah Alzahrani*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出面向模块化智能体的声明特定验证审计协议，用证据而非任务分数评估各组件改动，并在组合配置智能体上实证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统聚合任务分数无法说明改进是否可达、哪一组件损失价值，以及智能体自身检查能证明什么，因此需要按声明评估证据的方法。

Method: 审计记录每个结论、其证据、四种裁定（支持、不支持、未解决、未评估）及成立边界；三工具：Oracle策略在明确动作集下测可达改进，逐一替换组件为完美版定位价值损失，并单独测试验证器分数是否界定其声称量。

Result: 在合成市场已知隐藏状态的受限投资组合配置智能体上：完美状态信息价值取决于测量动作集；场景生成器丢弃大部分状态信号，提升局部保真度不改善决策；运行时验证器可被绕开且结果无可见变化。

Conclusion: 贡献是协议及其强制的证据区分；经验发现仅针对所研究的智能体与环境。

Abstract: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

</details>


### [410] [Grand Canonical Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00683)
*Andreas Burger,Malte Franke,Luka Mucko,Kjell Jorner,Alan Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出大正则生成器（GCG）框架，将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展到大正则系综，支持变粒子数采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有玻尔兹曼生成器主要针对正则系综，无法直接处理粒子数变化的开放系统。

Method: 设计两种方案：一是以化学势为条件联合采样粒子数与构型；二是将大正则分布分解为粒子数分布与对应正则玻尔兹曼密度，后者可复用任意正则生成器并解析编码化学势线性依赖，提供可处理似然以支持自归一化重要性采样。

Result: 在Lennard-Jones流体和沸石中甲烷吸附体系上，GCG准确复现大正则观测量，展现出跨化学势的泛化能力，并通过SNIS和大正则蒙特卡洛实现校正。

Conclusion: GCG为大正则系综提供了一种有效且可扩展的生成建模方法。

Abstract: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

</details>


### [411] [Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01378)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出生成溯源基板以记录合成训练数据的来源信息，并在日本护理交接管道中审计，发现溯源虽必要但不足以实现行为归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将模型行为归因于合成训练数据需要知道每个训练项的生产来源，而波形-标签对无法保留该知识，因此需要构建生成溯源基板。

Method: 定义合成研究对象绑定源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、评审谱系和不可变清单身份；在私有日本护理交接管道中审计113个资产（1.552小时合成语音，六个场景族），包含链接音频、转录、候选笔记和事实清单，并采用两个仅忠实清单（场景种子不相交且不可变版本化）。

Result: 所有项目均有链接音频、转录、候选笔记和事实清单，但人类证据具有选择性和来源特异性；精确上游归因受浮动生成器别名、缺失的每片段TTS和代码戳以及未版本化检查提示阻碍。

Conclusion: 生成溯源对于行为归因是必要但不充分的：它定义候选因果图和审计单元，而贡献性归因仍需冻结训练运行和干预或影响证据；贡献了紧凑溯源契约、审计协议和有界案例研究，不声称因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无限制公开发布。

Abstract: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

</details>


### [412] [Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00708)
*Honglei Brinkmann,Lucas Ng,Georgios Batzolis,Mark Girolami,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Willem Diepeveen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种面向多流形混合数据支撑的拉回几何，用潜变量高斯混合定义黎曼度量，并将其实例化于归一化流中，实现自适应混合学习、逐分量重建和局部有效维度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可扩展拉回构造通常假设单模态高斯潜分布，即数据接近单一流形；对多模态数据，将分离的模态映射到同一高斯区域需要较大传输形变，损害几何质量。

Method: 使用潜变量高斯混合，将黎曼度量定义为责任加权期望分量精度的矩阵平方；证明该度量光滑正定且退化为单分量高斯构造；对结构化重叠混合，给出沿测地线对数密度凹性的条件并推导局部曲率关系；在归一化流中实例化，支持自适应混合学习、活跃分量数由数据决定及分量重建。

Result: 在合成几何数据、具有已知参考轨迹的受控多视角图像设置和MNIST上，方法降低了传输畸变，具有竞争力的路径支撑，能接近恢复参考轨迹，并提升插值真实感。

Conclusion: 该工作将可扩展拉回几何扩展到不接近单一流形的数据集，同时保持局部结构的可处理性和可解释性。

Abstract: Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.
  We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations.
  We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.

</details>


### [413] [AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01389)
*Ali Koksal,Mei Chee Leong,Vicky Sintunata,Ching Ling Chin,Wee Teck Fong*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出AiSearch，一个利用视觉语言模型零样本能力实现图像与视频自然语言搜索的多模态检索框架，支持交互式反馈精炼和跨模型视觉基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代检索系统需同时满足自动化与交互性，允许用户实时搜索和精炼结果，因此需构建灵活的多模态检索框架。

Method: 利用视觉语言模型（VLMs）的零样本能力，以自然语言查询图像和视频，并通过用户反馈进行交互式搜索精炼，同时支持多VLM的视觉基准测试以选择合适模型。

Result: 实现了支持自然语言搜索、交互式结果精炼和跨VLM基准测试的多模态检索框架AiSearch。

Conclusion: AiSearch提供了一种灵活、可交互的多模态检索方案，能够按用户意图定制结果并辅助模型选择。

Abstract: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

</details>


### [414] [Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00729)
*Morgan Byrd,Maks Sorokin,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出仅以奖励和动作为条件的策略，实现观测空间完全不同的环境间零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略在新环境中适应困难且需要大量样本，而人类却具有出色的适应能力。

Method: 设计基于奖励的策略，仅以奖励和动作作为输入，并给出实用训练算法。

Result: 在Pointmass、Cartpole和2D Car Racing中训练，零样本迁移到不同颜色、3D渲染或Habitat-Sim中的Stretch机器人导航。

Conclusion: 基于奖励的策略可实现零样本迁移，并能在目标环境中进一步指导基于观测的策略训练。

Abstract: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

</details>


### [415] [Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00753)
*Syon Mansur,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文在自监督学习框架下研究了网络宽度和深度对贪婪逐层训练与端到端反向传播训练效果的影响，发现宽度增加可缩小两者性能差距，甚至使逐层训练更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习训练的主流方法，但已有研究探索了更简单的替代训练机制。然而，在避免端到端误差反向传播的局部优化网络中，何种架构条件能学到与端到端训练相当的表征尚不明确，本文旨在自监督学习背景下回答该问题。

Method: 研究卷积网络中网络宽度和深度对贪婪逐层自监督训练与端到端自监督训练效果的影响，并分析所形成表征的几何特性。

Result: 在更宽的网络中，端到端反向传播相对于贪婪逐层训练的优势缩小；在相对较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪婪逐层训练甚至取得更高性能。对表征的分析表明，非常宽的贪婪训练网络比端到端反向传播网络具有更有利的表征几何。

Conclusion: 宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配，表征几何的差异是贪婪逐层训练性能提升的潜在机制。

Abstract: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

</details>


### [416] [Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00767)
*Peter Nutter,Dani Roytburg,Clément Dumas,Jinghua Ou,Shi Feng*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出嫁接（grafting）方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将权重更新加到已后训练模型上，从而低成本模拟忠实的中期训练干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练阶段形成的信念决定模型后续泛化，但修改预训练语料必须重跑完整后训练才能评估效果，迭代慢且昂贵；常用做法是直接在已后训练模型上做SDF，却带来伪影、能力退化，并导致模型把与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实，即“现实漂移”。

Method: 在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后将学习到的权重更新叠加到已后训练模型，复用现有后训练流程来近似忠实的预/中期训练干预；在最多284B参数的多个模型家族上，通过植入虚假事实、训练失准模型有机体和应用宪法式中期训练干预进行验证。

Result: 嫁接在已后训练模型上安装目标信念的强度与SDF相当，同时将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失平均降低超过一半，并更接近忠实的中期训练运行。

Conclusion: 由于嫁接无需后训练，同一适配器可应用于任意后续检查点，使研究者仅以一次微调成本即可快速迭代预训练干预。

Abstract: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

</details>


### [417] [Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00771)
*Yimiao Yu,Florentin Guth*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文研究随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务间的迁移学习，发现等价迁移和非等价迁移两种模式，并将迁移分解为最后一层的幅度驱动迁移和非最后一层的结构驱动迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习的核心谜题是为什么在一个任务上预训练能加速或提升另一个任务的训练与性能，以及背后的机制是什么。

Method: 通过随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务，观察迁移模式；利用消融实验将迁移分解并定位为最后一层的“平凡”幅度驱动迁移和部分归因于其他层协方差的“非平凡”结构驱动迁移。

Result: 发现两种迁移模式：等价迁移（每多一个预训练epoch节省约一个下游微调epoch）和非等价迁移（不匹配任务的预训练比直接训练下游任务更高效）；迁移可分解为最后一层的幅度驱动效应和其他层的结构驱动效应。

Conclusion: 这些结果增进了对迁移学习内在机制的理解，并有望导向有原则的预训练策略。

Abstract: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

</details>


### [418] [Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00778)
*Daisuke Yamada,Travis Pence,Vikas Singh*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束critic的价值梯度，提升目标条件强化学习中的准度量学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准度量学习将目标到达代价建模为准度量距离，连接局部约束与全局价值几何，但现有局部约束未充分反映有限时域内控制组合的方向依赖效应及环境可行性。

Method: 基于状态约束最优控制，将动态可达性与边界几何解耦，并从数据中分别估计两者，用有限时域可达性约束critic的价值梯度。

Result: 在OGBench上，ReQRL优于或媲美现有准度量方法及其他离线GCRL方法。

Conclusion: ReQRL通过有限时域可达性约束有效改进了准度量学习，在离线目标条件强化学习基准上取得竞争性表现。

Abstract: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

</details>


### [419] [On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00820)
*Fabio J. Fehr,Philip Torr*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究探索是否可以从少量演示中直接生成专用模型，而非通过任务特定训练；在ARC-1D测试平台上，超网络能从上下文生成紧凑的专用模型参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用模型可通过上下文适应任务，专用模型虽参数少但功能专一，但获取专用模型通常需要任务特定训练或适配，因此研究者希望探索能否直接从少量演示样本中生成专用模型。

Method: 以ARC-1D作为受控测试平台，将单个变换表示为极小的专用模型，并训练一个超网络根据上下文生成这些专用模型的参数；在生成参数构成的权重空间中评估组合泛化能力及对未见变换的泛化能力，并比较移除显式任务标识符对泛化的影响。

Result: 生成的参数形成结构化的权重空间；专用模型表现出部分组合泛化以及对训练中未见变换的泛化能力；在两种设置中，移除显式任务标识符均能提升超出训练变换的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 结果证明少样本任务上下文可以即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，且生成的权重空间能够支持复用与超越已知函数的泛化。

Abstract: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

</details>


### [420] [TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00835)
*Jiawei Yu,Jian Liu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出了TrueMuse，一个用于文本到音乐生成数据归因的受控数据集与基准，通过微调扩散模型并利用已知的归因样本提供可靠的真值，系统评估了现有黑盒归因方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到音乐生成模型在大规模音乐数据集上训练，亟需量化单个训练样本贡献的数据归因方法，但现有方法因缺乏可靠真值而难以严格评估。

Method: 构建TrueMuse：精选归因样本，微调三个基于扩散的文本到音乐模型，提供受控归因目标；覆盖旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家风格和流派模式四种归因设置，包含133个属性、648个微调模型、95,456个生成样本和两种提示类型；从微调提升、提示类型难度、多任务训练和微调数据量四个维度评估现有黑盒归因方法。

Result: 归因仍然具有挑战性，现有方法在不同评估设置下表现出显著差异。

Conclusion: 需要更可靠且可泛化的文本到音乐生成归因方法；代码和数据集将在接收后发布。

Abstract: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [421] [The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01539)
*Alessio Buscemi,German Castignani,Daniele Pagani,Maxime Cordy,Jordi Cabot*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 为满足欧盟《人工智能法案》对AI监管沙盒（AIRS）的技术测试需求，本文提出11项架构与治理要求，并开发开源框架AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator，包含测试目录、统一数据模型、角色化仪表盘和分段报告，经早期试点验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》要求成员国在2027年8月前建立AI监管沙盒（AIRS），其中结构化技术测试需专用基础设施，但现有工具生态碎片化，输出难以比较、追溯和复用。

Method: 从AIRS程序条件和高风险系统义务推导出11项架构与治理要求；据此设计开源框架AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator，集成测试与控制目录（通过稳定插件API访问）、统一异构输出的共享数据模型、多学科角色仪表盘和受众分段报告；并开展早期试点。

Result: 框架架构和当前版本已实现，早期试点在真实AIRS参与中运行了协调与报告层，并促成官方退出报告。

Conclusion: 讨论了路线图、目录分层贡献模型引发的治理问题，以及开源评估生态在成员国间形成的制度路径。

Abstract: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. In response to these requirements, we introduce the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator, an open-source framework combining a curated Catalogue of tests and controls accessed through a stable plug-in API, a shared data model that harmonises heterogeneous outputs, role-specific dashboards for multi-disciplinary interpretation, and audience-segmented reporting. We describe the architecture and current release, and report an early-stage pilot that exercised the harmonisation and reporting layers within a live AIRS engagement and contributed to an official Exit Report. We discuss the roadmap, the governance questions raised by the Catalogue's tiered contribution model, and the institutional pathways through which an open-source assessment ecosystem could emerge across Member States.

</details>


### [422] [SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00838)
*Xinchen Du,Zhengze Zhou,Wenhui Zhu,Han Yu,Sen Na,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: SHARPO 提出一种面向 agentic RL 的段级信用分配方法，通过对 GRPO 优势施加基于师生对数概率差的段级乘子，提升 LLM 多步决策性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程多步交互中，单个局部错误即可导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励难以为单步决策提供细粒度信用分配。

Method: 受 on-policy self-distillation 启发，SHARPO 在环境交互段级别计算 teacher-student 对数概率差，并据此生成有界乘子作用于 GRPO 优势，段内所有 token 共享该乘子，实现跨段信用差异。

Result: 基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，SHARPO 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 基准上优于 GRPO、SDAR、RLSD 和 StepOPSD 等基线。

Conclusion: 段级事后优势重加权可有效细化 GRPO 的信用分配，提升 LLM 在长程多步 agent 任务中的表现。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

</details>


### [423] [Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890)
*Sushant Mehta,Logan Ritchie,Edwin Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 通过仅使用强化学习（RL）在1700个专家构建的智能体编程任务上对Kimi K2.7 Code进行后训练，显著提升了跨多个基准的通过率，并证明所学能力可迁移至训练分布之外。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体常存在“最后一公里”问题：完成大部分功能但遗漏需求、仅测试已实现用例、破坏原有行为或基于未经验证的假设。研究旨在验证RL能否弥合这一差距，且所学能力能否泛化。

Method: 对1T参数（32B激活）的MoE模型Kimi K2.7 Code，仅用RL在1700个任务上后训练：1000个仓库任务由隐藏的fail-to-pass和pass-to-pass测试评分，700个终端任务由专家编写的隐藏验证器评分。奖励为目标检查通过比例，任一pass-to-pass测试失败则奖励归零。在rank-32 LoRA适配器上执行一个epoch的GSPO。

Result: 在六个外部基准、三种智能体框架上pass@1均提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8，DeepSWE 31.0→43.4，Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0，Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1，Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6，SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0。五个独立任务集汇总提升显著（p<0.001），且对训练数据收集后发布的三个集仍显著（p=0.004）；在训练未使用的两种框架下也提升。DeepSWE和Terminal-Bench 3的中位轨迹步数缩短24-35%。

Conclusion: 仅用RL后训练可有效解决编码智能体的最后一公里问题，提升多种基准表现，并泛化到训练分布外及未见过框架；配对轨迹显示新解任务避免了四类失败模式。

Abstract: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

</details>


### [424] [vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01718)
*Seok Bin Son,Samuel Yen-Chi Chen,Soohyun Park,Joongheon Kim*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出vFedProtoQNAS，通过原型共享实现个性化量子神经架构搜索，避免异构QNN参数聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子联邦学习中设备能力差异导致单一共享QNN架构不适用，而个性化QNAS中不同结构QNN参数平均会混合语义不一致的电路操作。

Method: 每个客户端独立搜索和训练客户端特定QNN，计算潜在表示的类级局部原型，并利用服务器全局原型作为联邦语义锚进行精炼；模型参数不跨客户端聚合，联邦协作仅通过类级原型共享实现。

Result: 实验表明vFedProtoQNAS比FedAvg准确率提升3.70%，并增强类一致表示对齐。

Conclusion: 原型引导的个性化QNAS能有效解决量子联邦学习中的架构异构问题，实现无需参数聚合的联邦协作。

Abstract: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

</details>


### [425] [VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01766)
*Bingjun Luo,Yuhuan Fan,Jialin Guo,Siqi Li*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出VideoEvolve框架，自动演化围绕冻结视频-语言模型的智能体harness，以提升视频时序定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖人工诊断定位失败并协调修改智能体工作流与指令，成本高、效率低。

Method: 采用Cloze-Structured Harness Representation保持阶段接口同时开放工作流与指令演化；Branch-Guided Harness Evolution保留有潜力的代码分支，利用执行反馈引导局部编辑，并通过验证决定保留哪些改进。

Result: 在多个基准上定位性能提升；组件分析表明指令精炼是稳定增益来源，演化代码的收益因评估设置而异。

Conclusion: 自动化harness演化是提升视频时序定位的有效途径，代码已开源。

Abstract: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .

</details>


### [426] [Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00903)
*Zhanming Zhang,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出“入口状态锐化”：在测试时强化学习（TTRL）之前用无数据训练把通用检查点调整到更易被无标签自适应利用的状态，并以入口策略熵作为无标签控制信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTRL 依赖模型自身采样产生自监督信号，检查点的入口状态因此很关键：策略分布越弥散，自监督越噪声化，有限的自适应预算可能被大量消耗在概率质量集中上，而非表达模型已具备的能力。

Method: 基于 Qwen3-4B 构造五个无数据检查点，在同一 15 步 TTRL 协议下评估；比较不同无数据目标（如 R-Zero、SPIRAL）导致的入口状态差异，并加入域内无标签自蒸馏干预以验证入口状态可被主动锐化。

Result: 入口策略熵强烈排序端点转换效率（Spearman ρ=-0.90；控制入口可达性后 ρ=-0.99）。R-Zero 入口熵 3.39 nats，在 MATH、GPQA、AMC 的 6/6 配对比较中低于未调优基座；SPIRAL 入口熵 0.07 nats，尽管自博弈阶段未用数学数据，仍在 MATH 和 GPQA 上取得最高 TTRL 后准确率。

Conclusion: 应将检查点准备视为状态控制问题：用无数据训练提升 TTRL 就绪度，以入口熵作为无标签控制信号、以可达能力为约束。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. Across five data-free checkpoints derived from Qwen3-4B and evaluated under an identical 15-step TTRL protocol, entry policy entropy strongly rank-orders endpoint conversion efficiency, a reliability-to-reachability measure (Spearman $ρ=-0.90$; $ρ=-0.99$ after controlling for entry reachability). The contrast across objectives is striking: R-Zero remains diffuse at $3.39$ nats and finishes below the untuned base in 6/6 matched comparisons across MATH, GPQA, and AMC, whereas SPIRAL reaches $0.07$ nats and achieves the highest post-TTRL accuracy on MATH and GPQA despite its self-play stage using no math training data. An in-domain label-free self-distillation intervention further shows that the entry state can be deliberately sharpened. These results motivate treating checkpoint preparation as a \emph{state-control problem}: use data-free training to improve TTRL readiness, with entry entropy as a label-free control signal and reachable capability as the constraint.

</details>


### [427] [Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01787)
*Beining Wu,Zihao Ding,Jun Huang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出组件路由方法，将GUI智能体的经验轨迹拆分为定位器、流程、状态事实和教训四类组件，并决定每类组件应存入模型权重还是上下文，从而优于整条轨迹的使用方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进GUI智能体在比较微调（存入权重）与检索（放入上下文）两种经验利用方式时结论矛盾，作者认为原因在于轨迹混合了不同性质的组件，导致结论依赖于组件构成。

Method: 引入组件路由：将经验拆分为定位器、流程、状态事实和教训，在相同项目上跨三个骨干家族、两个环境和三个种子比较两种去向；基于训练前可测的重复性和状态条件性拟合规则预测去向，并进行干预实验验证边界；分析训练及生产者-消费者差异如何改变两种去向的价值。

Result: 同一经验池中定位器和教训在权重中更优，流程和状态事实在上下文中更优；规则在24/24单元中正确恢复留出骨干家族的去向，两种干预可将组件推向边界；按规则路由优于所有整条轨迹基线，平均比每个骨干的最佳单一去向高3.5个百分点；权重写入后笔记读出下降（重复项最明显），上下文增益随信息差距增大，权重增益随策略差距减小。

Conclusion: 经验利用效果取决于组件类型而非整条轨迹，基于重复性和状态条件性的路由规则可有效指导组件去向，且训练与生产者-消费者差异会动态影响两种去向的价值。

Abstract: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.

</details>


### [428] [LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01800)
*Haochen Zhang,Laura Yao,Zachary Plotkin,Gengwei Zhang,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出LineupRL，一种基于可验证奖励的强化学习流水线，利用冻结大语言模型作为验证器，通过标题到序列的识别任务提供奖励，显著提升时间序列描述生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督微调依赖更大模型生成标题，质量受限；强化学习奖励设计多针对其他模态任务，难以迁移到时间序列开放生成领域。

Method: LineupRL采用RLVR流程，奖励模型为冻结LLM验证器，读取生成的标题和候选时间序列的原始数值（而非图表），从多个干扰项中选出被描述的序列。

Result: 在两个描述基准及仅依赖标题的预测和重建任务上，LineupRL在所有指标上超越SFT和RL基线；训练的3B视觉语言模型以1/24参数量超越72B VLM（SFT基线蒸馏来源）。

Conclusion: LineupRL能抵抗奖励黑客，训练的描述器既能追踪趋势又能命名关键点数值，验证了基于识别的奖励在时间序列描述任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. Matching is a far lighter demand on the verifier than writing questions or judging a caption, so an off-the-shelf LLM can supply the reward. Across two captioning benchmarks, and on forecasting and reconstruction where the predictor sees only the caption, LineupRL outperforms SFT and RL baselines on every metric. The 3B vision language model (VLM) trained by LineupRL also outperforms, at 1/24 of the parameters, the 72B VLM whose captions the SFT baseline is distilled from. Our case study shows that LineupRL resists reward hacking, and that the captioner it trains both traces the trend and names the values at key points.

</details>


### [429] [Platonic Task Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00929)
*Junghwan Park,Woojin Cho*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出普拉图任务向量假说，并用通用任务描述符实现跨异构模型的任务知识迁移与组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对同一任务的专用模型行为相似，但其参数更新缺乏共享坐标系，导致权重空间的任务算术无法跨架构迁移。受柏拉图洞穴寓言启发，作者假设模型特定更新是同一模型无关对象（普拉图任务向量）的投影。

Method: 提出通用任务描述符：形状与架构和嵌入维度无关的矩阵，记录任务功能效果并支持矩阵加减。迁移时，仅用任务的无标签探针图像和类名提示，通过编辑目标模型使其复现描述符。实现方式有两种：(1) 将描述符分解为图像嵌入上的位移场，用最小二乘求解线性算子并折叠进目标末层作为权重编辑，线性性使算子库可按任意强度以符号和组合；(2) 训练低秩适配器，覆盖所有层并联合拟合组合，但每次编辑需一次优化。

Result: 异构模型仅部分共享该对象，模型特定残差的范数与共享分量相当，但跨模型迁移仍保留目标自身描述符74-80%的增益。在六个模型家族、八个分类任务及一个音频-文本设置上的实验表明，任务知识可在异构模型间迁移与组合。

Conclusion: 任务知识可表示为模型无关的通用任务描述符，并在异构模型间实现迁移与组合，支持两种实现方式。

Abstract: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.

</details>


### [430] [AI-assisted mitotic counting improves reproducibility and efficiency across multiple tumour types](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01813)
*Simon Graham,Mostafa Jahanifar,Quoc Dang Vu,Vygante Maskoliunaite,Donatas Petroska,Ruta Barbora Valkiuniene,Ayat Gamal Lashen,Jen Hong Ong,Amede Ogechi Nnorom,Sinclair Couper,Natasha Kardasz,Reshma Agrawal,Brinder Singh Chohan,Jose Luis Solorzano Rendon,Shonali Natu,Arvydas Laurinavicius,Nasir Rajpoot,David Snead*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: MitPro人工智能工具通过引导病理学家关注高预测有丝分裂活性区域并标记有丝分裂象，提高了有丝分裂计数的可重复性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动有丝分裂计数耗时且存在病理学家间变异，需要提高一致性和效率。

Method: 回顾性、非干预性配对读者研究，使用385张全切片图像（来自3个国家3个中心，7种肿瘤类型，3种扫描仪），13位病理学家在无AI辅助和有AI辅助（洗脱期至少2周）下独立评估每张切片。

Result: AI辅助计数使组内相关系数从0.589提高到0.949；病理学家中位评估时间从286.4秒降至127.8秒，平均节省151.8秒；支持性分析（HALO AP和Sectra系统及2种额外肿瘤类型）也显示一致性和效率改善；AI辅助与更高的有丝分裂计数和评分轻微相关，评分变化频率与常规计数中病理学家间变异相当。

Conclusion: MitPro可作为辅助工具，在常规实践中实现更一致、更高效的有丝分裂评估。

Abstract: Mitotic counting is an important component of tumour grading, diagnosis and prognostic assessment across several tumour types, but manual assessment is time-consuming and subject to inter-pathologist variability. To help address these challenges, we developed MitPro, an AI tool designed to improve consistency and efficiency by directing pathologists towards regions with the highest predicted mitotic activity and highlighting mitotic figures for review, while retaining pathologist control over region selection and the final count. We evaluated its effect on the reproducibility and efficiency of mitotic counting in a retrospective, non-interventional, paired reader study comprising 385 whole-slide images from 3 centres in 3 countries and 7 tumour types using 3 different scanners. 13 pathologists participated, with each slide assessed independently by 3 pathologists without AI assistance and again with AI assistance after a minimum 2 week washout period. Across all slides, AI-assisted counting increased the intraclass correlation coefficient from 0.589 to 0.949. Mean pathologist-level median assessment time decreased from 286.4 to 127.8 seconds, corresponding to an average saving of 151.8 seconds per assessment. Improvements in agreement and efficiency were also observed in supporting analyses using HALO AP and Sectra image management systems and in 2 additional tumour types outside the main study population. AI-assisted assessment was associated with a subtle shift towards higher mitotic counts and scores, consistent with identification of more active mitotic hotspots and fewer missed mitotic figures. The frequency of score change between unassisted and AI-assisted assessment was comparable with inter-pathologist variation during routine counting. These findings support the use of MitPro as an assistive tool for more consistent and efficient mitotic assessment in routine practice.

</details>


### [431] [On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01842)
*Haochen Zhang,Jiaheng Guo,Zhen Xu,Zachary Plotkin,Nicholas Konz,Zhen Tan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出时间序列世界模型（TSWM）的形式化与基准，揭示预测精度与机制一致性之间的分离，并给出兼顾两者的设计配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSWM以预测误差为训练和评估指标，但未检验其对未执行计划变更的响应是否与真实系统一致。

Method: 形式化区分状态、动作与外生输入，区分连续、模式和事件动作，提出基于已声明动作-状态关系的机制一致性指标；构建整合八个公开数据集的基准，覆盖预测空间、计划融合与计划编码等设计，在七个骨干网络和五个随机种子上评估；提出方向性监督损失。

Result: 冻结潜在预测空间使MAE平均降低9.9%，门控输出融合较输入拼接降低12.7%，时间计划编码影响不超过2.2%；预测误差与机制一致性出现分离，最低误差配置在五个含已声明机制数据集中的四个上一致性不高于随机水平；方向性监督显著提升被惩罚机制的一致性且不改变MAE。

Conclusion: TSWM设计应结合冻结潜在空间与输出侧融合以提升精度，并采用方向性监督训练目标以保障机制一致性。

Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

</details>


### [432] [Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00991)
*Jonathan Williams,Esin Tureci Karthik R. Narasimhan*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 将RLVR训练与多数投票组合会因策略输出错误相关性增加而损害投票性能；将相同预算分散训练多个LoRA适配器（适配器丛林）能提升投票准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准流程先用RLVR训练单个策略，再多次采样投票，但投票只能纠正投票者不共享的错误，而RLVR会使策略样本错误趋同，导致组合损失。

Method: 每个问题采样160个补全；比较全量RLVR训练的单个LoRA适配器与将相同数据和训练预算随机不相交地分配给K个LoRA适配器（适配器丛林），并设置早停控制。

Result: 全量训练提升单样本准确率，但在四个模型中的三个上多数投票低于未训练基座模型，最高下降4.8分；投票准确率早期达峰后下降达7.0分。适配器丛林在全部16个（模型，K）设置中投票表现优于全量适配器，K≥4时与基座模型差距在0.8分以内或更高；K≥8时在八项中的六项优于早停控制；投票数从16增至160时，丛林领先优势从1.3分扩大到3.3分。

Conclusion: 当计划采样并投票时，RLVR预算应广度优先而非深度优先。

Abstract: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.

</details>


### [433] [Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01028)
*Sung Ho Jo,Seonghwi Kim,Wonsang Yun,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出基于最优传输的样本重加权框架POTER，在子群体偏移和标签噪声下提升最差组准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于损失信号的重加权方法在标签噪声下信号失真，误标样本可能因高损失污染重训练，且该交叉问题研究不足。

Method: 利用最优传输度量训练分布与基于有限验证组标注构建的参考分布之间的样本级传输几何，得到样本重要性权重；仅需单阶段ERM训练，无需重训练。

Result: 在标准基准和噪声标签设置下，包括标签损坏集中于少数子群的情况，POTER取得最差组准确率的最优性能。

Conclusion: POTER通过传输几何替代损失信号，能有效降低误标或强偏置对齐样本权重，在子群体偏移与标签噪声联合场景下优于现有方法。

Abstract: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.

</details>


### [434] [SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02023)
*Hyeonmin Lee,Zheng Wei,Kyungmin Kwon,Jumin Seo,Jiwon Park,Hayoung Oh*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: SPHERE 是一个自适应 VR 生成框架，通过提取持久空间偏好并将孤立合成转变为持续的人机协同创作，实现个性化、几何稳健的 3D 室内场景生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的 3D 室内场景合成流程无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，导致沉浸式创作过程重复且造成身体疲劳。

Method: SPHERE 从语音和控制器编辑等自然多模态交互中提取持久空间偏好；将原始编辑抽象为分层约束，建模局部功能与全局拓扑上下文以增强几何韧性；并采用人在回路强化学习，根据用户最终编辑的场景动态更新检索策略。

Result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）与离线消融实验表明，SPHERE 显著减少了纠正性编辑和身体负荷，避免了偏向浅层物体级特征的偏差，生成了几何稳健且与用户画像对齐的布局。

Conclusion: SPHERE 证明了捕获演示的空间逻辑可实现受控的空间自适应，为沉浸式创作建立了可靠、可治理的人机协作框架。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE

</details>


### [435] [Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01165)
*Shengye Tao,Yinzhu Cheng,Haihua Xie*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究探究语言模型预训练过程中逐层介入响应是持久组织还是训练瞬态，通过单块恒等旁路实验发现其深度敏感性结构化但非静态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逐层介入分析多基于单一训练检查点，忽略了预训练中表征与计算随训练演化，无法区分持久组织与瞬态训练效应。

Method: 在固定教师强制上下文上对五个已发布训练轨迹和11个模型-领域组合进行单块恒等旁路；分析检查点间秩对应、变化位置跨样本与跨领域迁移，并做控制实验比较局部缺失更新幅度与匹配下游响应。

Result: 旁路响应保留可识别的深度排序但幅度重分布，邻近检查点秩对应更强，大变化集中于跨样本复现且跨域迁移的位置；Pythia复现中局部缺失更新幅度增大而池化匹配下游响应减小，OLMo-2 7B呈不同平衡，匹配响应还依赖扰动强度与方向，未发现定向补偿。

Conclusion: 纵向层敏感性是有结构但非静态的，单检查点介入响应应结合底层扰动通路在训练中的演化来解释。

Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

</details>


### [436] [Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01168)
*Roberto Stanzione,Jules Barbe,Magali Parrino,Jérémie Fourmann,Paul Boniol*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出SHAD基准，包含215个来自分布式云存储系统的多变量高维时间序列，提供丰富语义标注，用于评估异常检测、可解释性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测基准主要关注检测精度，缺乏对领域上下文、可解释性和可解释性的评估，尤其缺乏足够的语义标注来生成人类可理解的异常解释。

Method: 构建SHAD基准，采集真实分布式云存储系统的215个多变量高维时间序列，涵盖三种异常家族及不同严重程度，并评估检测、可解释性（维度贡献归因）和可解释性（冻结LLM定位与解释异常）的基线方法。

Result: 在SHAD上基准测试了多种现有异常检测器，评估了通过维度贡献进行异常归因的准确性，并探究了冻结LLM在定位和解释异常方面的有效性。

Conclusion: SHAD填补了现有基准在语义标注和可解释性评估方面的空白，为时间序列异常检测 pipeline 的检测、可解释性和可解释性研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

</details>


### [437] [Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01175)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yuxuan Li,Lu Han,Ali Anaissi,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出双瓶颈信息正则化方法，通过全局KL与条件KL分别控制整体容量和条件内信息，以分离任务相关结构与干扰变异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准信息瓶颈使用单一标量I(Z;X)进行全局压缩，无法独立调节标签相关结构与条件内残差变异，导致干扰信息残留并在数据受限时过拟合，损害泛化。

Method: 基于标签诱导划分重新审视IB，构建双瓶颈：标准KL项控制全局信息容量，条件KL项针对条件内信息；证明条件KL可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配项，并采用单纯形结构条件先验实现可控隐空间几何。

Result: 在分类与分割实验中，低数据分类取得最明显增益，密集预测基准上获得一致改进。

Conclusion: 双瓶颈公式能显式分离干扰变异与任务支撑结构，提供可控表示几何，并可无缝集成到现有流程中。

Abstract: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. To address this limitation, we revisit IB from a structuredperspective based on a label-induced partition, where condition-level structure and within-condition information playdistinct roles. This leads to a dual-bottleneck formulation: a standard KL term controls global information capacity, while aconditional KL term targets within-condition information. We show that the conditional KL admits an exact decompositioninto a within-condition information term and a prior-mismatch term, explaining its alignment with the design objective.With a simplex-structured conditional prior, the method provides controllable latent geometry and integrates seamlesslyinto existing pipelines.
