Experiments on classification and segmentation show the clearest gains in low-data classificationand consistent improvements across dense prediction benchmarks.

</details>


### [438] [Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01193)
*Yunrui Guan,Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流匹配的反事实生成方法，结合样本分割双稳健训练目标与源-目标结果的学习耦合，并利用得分校正随机采样器实现有限步生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实生成旨在利用事实分配机制下的观测数据，对假设干预或决策下的结果进行采样，现有方法在有限步离散化与耦合依赖的理论保证上存在不足。

Method: 采用流匹配框架，设计样本分割双稳健训练目标，学习观测源结果与条件结果模型抽取的目标结果之间的耦合；使用基于高斯平滑插值的得分校正随机采样器支持有限步生成；理论分析建立耦合敏感的KL界，控制常步欧拉离散化误差。

Result: 主要理论贡献是耦合敏感的KL界，误差由所选耦合下源-目标位移的矩控制，而非速度场的全局均匀正则性，且对环境维度呈近线性依赖；同时给出学习速度场与得分场的有限样本非参数保证，分离近似、耦合替换、 nuisance估计、泛化和蒙特卡洛误差，得到端到端保证。在合成和半合成图像基准上，实验支持耦合依赖理论，并表明在有限离散化预算下随机采样器可优于确定性ODE采样器。

Conclusion: 该工作为反事实生成提供了具有有限步采样保证的流匹配方法，理论分析揭示了耦合对离散化误差的控制作用，实验验证了随机采样器在有限步下的优势。

Abstract: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

</details>


### [439] [Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01204)
*Yihao Ding,Daniel Yitian Su,Yiran Zhang,Christopher M. Gonzalez,Wei Liu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出DrillBench基准，用于钻孔子层预测与自回归地层生成，并基于迁移边界发现设计了一种结合大规模预训练与空间检索的通用方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归建模在语言与序列任务中表现优异，而钻孔岩性随钻探深度顺序揭示，天然适合自回归预测；但现有钻孔建模多聚焦空间插值、重建或掩码建模，严格的自回归预测尚未充分探索。

Method: 构建包含49,671个西澳钻孔的DrillBench基准，覆盖从局部预测、空间偏移到跨地质省迁移的渐进迁移谱；评测经典、地统计和神经模型，并开发骨干无关的配方：在历史钻孔上大规模预训练，并结合邻近岩性的空间检索。

Result: 基准测试揭示明显的迁移边界：空间与地球化学条件在局部带来大幅增益，但在更强偏移下急剧下降，而岩性序列自回归模型迁移更稳健；检索在风化覆盖层最有效，预训练在基岩和更广泛地质偏移下贡献更大，二者结合在保持局部性能的同时提升了空间与跨省迁移泛化，尤其在最远分割上最显著。

Conclusion: 钻孔自回归预测应兼顾序列建模与空间信息，预训练与空间检索互补可缓解迁移边界问题，DrillBench为相关研究提供了基准与代码支持。

Abstract: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/yihaoding/drillbench.

</details>


### [440] [Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01223)
*David Berghaus*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 利用大语言模型自主搜索程序，发现两个轻量级时序异常检测器，在TSB-AD基准上领先，无需网络训练与GPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序异常检测需在预测精度、计算效率与可解释性之间权衡，现有方法难以兼顾；探索LLM驱动程序搜索作为实用路径。

Method: 将LLM作为检测器作者而非检测器本身，在无泄漏目标下反复编辑单个短NumPy程序，保留最优检测器；发现单变量和多变量两个紧凑检测器，用局部谱特征描述短窗口，并通过协方差感知距离与训练区域分布比较。

Result: 在TSB-AD基准上，这两个检测器在各项指标上领先，超越最强经典、深度和基础模型基线（包括Time-RCD）；不训练网络、不使用GPU，多变量检测器比所有性能相近的基线更快。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是获得准确、高效且透明检测器的实用途径。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

</details>


### [441] [Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01238)
*SeongHyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Seungyoo Lee,Jiyeon Ham,Yunju Bak,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)，通过让各分支在目标偏置的数据混合上训练，使其在权重空间可合并，从而在多目标后训练中优于朴素合并并保持行为分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一语言模型需在单套参数中整合数学、代码、指令跟随与可控思考等异构能力。顺序后训练会沿单一优化轨迹纠缠所有目标，对训练顺序、数据比例、调度与停止准则高度敏感；而直接合并单目标专家常因权重空间几何不相容而失败：领域能力骤降或 think/non-think 模式坍缩为单一主导行为。

Method: MTM 让每个分支在目标偏置的数据混合而非单目标数据上训练，引入跨目标交互以提升合并时的兼容性。以合并模型评估作为低成本信号来选择分支混合，避免昂贵的数据混合消融。流程迭代进行：每轮用全局选定的合并系数提升基础模型，并在保持其他目标的约束下，用领域偏好系数细化各分支混合。为超越单纯形网格搜索，采用基于 qNEHVI 的多目标贝叶斯优化。

Result: 在代码、数学、指令跟随以及 think/non-think 控制上，MTM 优于朴素合并，并在单目标合并发生坍缩之处仍保持行为分离。

Conclusion: 有效的统一模型需要被训练成“可合并”的分支，即分支应面向合并兼容性而非单目标最优来训练。

Abstract: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [442] [IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01269)
*Luca Geminiani,Nadja Klein*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出IQS-BO，一种基于PFN的贝叶斯优化方法，通过监督学习直接预测候选点最优概率，实现高效全上下文优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BO方法需每步重拟合代理模型并最大化采集函数，计算昂贵；PFN类方法虽摊销代理，但仍依赖数值优化采集函数或固定决策规则，缺乏灵活性与监督信号。

Method: IQS-BO在合成先验上监督训练PFN，单次前向预测每个候选点最大化目标的概率，其目标函数最小化对应后验概率；可独立用于全上下文BO，或以固定概率代理预测为输入仅摊销决策；并提出混合先验预训练PFN，结合GP样本与扭曲输入、孤立窄最优、平台等非平稳函数。

Result: 在合成与真实基准上，IQS-BO查询成本远低于基于采集函数的方法，性能匹配或超越标准GP-BO及现有上下文方法；混合先验预训练进一步提升优化表现。

Conclusion: IQS-BO通过监督学习实现高效、灵活的上下文贝叶斯优化，减少查询成本并保持优越性能，混合先验有助于捕捉非平稳函数特征。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

</details>


### [443] [Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01270)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Dhiraj Golhar,Ummesalma Diwan,Sourish Dasgupta,Manjunath Joshi,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出REPAIR方法，通过比较缓存表示与当前偏好状态，学习紧凑坐标空间中的校正证据，修复个性化编码器压缩后的状态，提升推荐与生成任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅依赖个性化编码器输出的偏好状态进行任务预测，会丢失冻结编码器缓存中单个时间步的有用证据，存在可恢复性差距。

Method: REPAIR在紧凑学习坐标空间中比较缓存表示与当前偏好状态，在长历史、近期交互和局部突发上解析校正证据，选择模式与时间步并聚合校正后加入状态，且复用现有前向计算表示，无需重编码；仅训练REPAIR，编码器与任务头保持冻结。

Result: 在MovieLens、PENS、MIND和Amazon Reviews 2023上，对十二个推荐宿主提升MRR和nDCG@10，优于仅微调任务头；例如Mamba4Rec在MovieLens上MRR提升3.96点（仅头微调0.19点）。在个性化生成中，IMPerSumm将两个加权PerSEval变体提升至多25.23%。

Conclusion: 结果支持压缩后状态校正，并区分偏好证据的可用性与下游使用，表明REPAIR能有效恢复被压缩丢失的偏好证据。

Abstract: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

</details>


### [444] [Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01318)
*Hanna Malet,Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 在有限预算的数据回流场景下，扩散模型虽保留全部真实数据，但每代仅从不断增大的数据池中采样固定大小训练集，真实数据比例趋于零，导致部分特征逐步退化而非完全崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既往关于模型崩溃的研究结论看似矛盾：用合成数据完全替代真实数据会导致崩溃，但在合成数据中持续加入真实数据可防止崩溃。本文旨在厘清这一分歧，研究介于两者之间的有限预算训练机制。

Method: 针对扩散模型，设定所有历史数据集与真实数据均被保留，但每个新模型仅从不断增长的数据池中抽取固定大小的样本进行训练。在二维螺旋数据集以及MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10图像基准上开展实验，并建立多代参数动态的线性响应模型，通过随机递归分析其演化。

Result: 替换协议（仅用合成数据替代真实数据）使数据集迅速退化，与文献一致；固定预算协议仅造成部分退化，保留部分特征。线性响应模型分析表明：两种协议下都有一部分特征脆弱，在几代内丢失；而在固定预算协议下，另一部分特征具有鲁棒性，可在近乎无界的代际中得以保留。

Conclusion: 模型崩溃并非全有或全无：在保留全部真实数据但采样预算固定的典型有限预算流程中，退化是选择性的，部分特征持久保留，部分特征快速丢失。这解释了既往结论的表面矛盾，并为数据回流的实际部署提供理论依据。

Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

</details>


### [445] [Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01399)
*Alessandro Montenegro,Riccardo Venturelli,Marco Mussi,Matteo Papini,Alberto Maria Metelli*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了PPO中样本重用机制的有效性，提出基于多重重要性加权的两种变体wPPO-U和wPPO-BH，在连续控制任务中分析数据重用对样本效率和最终性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPO作为on-policy深度强化学习的标准方法，样本效率低；off-policy方法通过经验回放提高效率但训练不稳定。现有结合PPO与off-policy数据重用的混合策略虽提升样本效率，但缺乏对重用何时有效、在何种场景下有效及有效程度的系统研究。

Method: 在多重重要性加权框架下实例化两种PPO变体，均保留PPO核心机制，仅重用最近若干迭代窗口内的样本，以隔离数据重用效应。wPPO-U使用普通重要性权重，wPPO-BH使用平衡启发式校正权重。为二者推导策略改进下界，提供理论依据。

Result: 在连续控制任务上实证研究了数据重用对PPO样本效率和最终性能的影响，明确了重用改善性能的条件与方式。

Conclusion: 通过系统实验与理论下界，揭示了样本重用在PPO中的有效性边界，为设计更高效的混合on-policy/off-policy强化学习算法提供了指导。

Abstract: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.

</details>


### [446] [FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01515)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出FedMIX-P，在联邦学习的每个本地步骤中混合共享与本地预条件器，缓解异构客户端几何导致的更新偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应预条件器能加速训练，但客户端几何异构会使联邦更新产生偏差；仅靠轮次开始同步无法阻止本地训练中偏差重现。

Method: FedMIX-P在每个本地步骤混合共享和本地预条件器，保留本地适应并降低算子均方失配；针对光滑非凸目标、随机梯度和部分参与，采用合适步长与随轮次变化的混合权重进行收敛分析。

Result: 理论证明达到O(R^{-1/2})的平稳性界，且不要求本地预条件器相互收敛；给出双客户端反例说明固定正混合可能保留非平稳不动点；实验在视觉和语言任务上使用SOAP、Sophia和Muon变体，相比对应本地优化器有提升，准确率最高提升19.47个百分点，60M–350M语言模型验证损失更低。

Conclusion: FedMIX-P有效缓解异构预条件器偏差并提升性能，但理论仅覆盖有界线性对称正定预条件器；完整非线性和基于动量的更新需要单独分析。

Abstract: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $λ^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. Experiments with SOAP, Sophia, and Muon variants across vision and language tasks show improvements over corresponding local optimizers, including accuracy gains of up to $19.47$ percentage points and lower validation loss for 60M--350M language models. Full nonlinear and momentum-based updates require separate analysis.

</details>


### [447] [Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01548)
*Ryunyi Lee,Kangjun Noh,Somin Kim,Heedong Kim,Kyungwoo Song*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出Range-GRPO半监督后训练框架，将LLM-as-a-Judge伪奖励表示为共形校准的奖励区间，并在GRPO中直接进行区间配对比较以保留奖励不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练依赖可靠监督，但无参考答案或可执行验证器的领域标注成本高；LLM-as-a-Judge虽可提供可扩展伪奖励，但单点分数无法显式表达奖励不确定性。

Method: 将伪奖励建模为共形校准的奖励范围，结合少量标注数据与未标注提示进行半监督后训练；在GRPO框架下，目标函数对每个rollout组内的奖励区间进行成对比较，而非将其退化为点奖励，使区间不确定性同时影响学习信号的大小与方向；并给出理论分析。

Result: 理论分析表明，当所有奖励区间退化为点时，该目标可恢复Dr.GRPO优势；实验中，在评估的半监督方法中取得最高的分布内与分布外平均性能，且训练资源需求更少。

Conclusion: Range-GRPO通过区间化伪奖励与配对比较，有效利用奖励不确定性，在降低监督与训练成本的同时提升半监督后训练性能，并兼容现有GRPO优势形式。

Abstract: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the Dr.GRPO advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.

</details>


### [448] [QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01554)
*Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出QK-Wanda，一种在未掩码预RoPE重建目标下，联合评估查询和键权重剪枝成本的方法，以提升大语言模型QK投影剪枝效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wanda独立对每个线性投影内的权重打分，但查询和键通过点积交互，独立打分忽略了这种耦合关系，可能导致剪枝准则次优。

Method: QK-Wanda用未掩码预RoPE重建目标下各自删除成本对查询和键权重打分，并引入对侧投影信息（键辅助查询权重、查询辅助键权重），使两投影共享剪枝预算；分数为闭式解，无需梯度或权重更新。

Result: 在TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3、Qwen2.5共15个0.5B-72B模型上，50%稀疏度下QK重建误差平均降低60%，80%下降低45%；Llama 2 70B在80%稀疏度下WikiText-2和C4困惑度分别下降20.3%和13.5%，零样本平均准确率提升5.94个百分点；Qwen2.5-72B也改善，但Llama-3.1-70B虽然重建误差更低，困惑度却显著更高。

Conclusion: 耦合剪枝准则具有潜力，但局部重建误差作为模型质量预测指标存在局限；剪枝开销仅比Wanda高约1.3%（A100）和3.1%（H200）。

Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

</details>


### [449] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文研究在预训练视觉Transformer中放置任务特定适配器的最佳位置，提出利用冻结的fMRI编码模型观察首任务以确定适配器分配的方法LS-B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中为每个任务保存适配器会线性增加存储，而仅在少数块中放置适配器虽能限制增长，但如何选择放置位置尚不明确。

Method: 从算法角度，训练所有连续四块放置并分析准确率与深度关系；从神经科学角度，受视觉皮层层级组织与中期可塑性启发，提出LS-B：用十二个人类视觉区的冻结fMRI编码模型观察首任务，将任务特定容量一次性分配给跨任务读出变化最大而结构稳定的块。

Result: 在三个ViT-B/16骨干上，LS-B产生稳定的骨干特定分配；在AugReg和iBOT上选块与搜索确定的中等深度区域重叠；在匹配存储和观察预算下，所选块优于最浅和最深的四块配置；在Split ImageNet-R上，LS-B使用60%的全BiLoRA适配器存储，最终准确率差距在1.5个百分点内。

Conclusion: LS-B无需标签或反向传播，增加不到0.6%的运行时间，并表现出骨干特定的皮层特征，为适配器放置提供了一种无需搜索的有效策略。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [450] [Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01601)
*Guy Amit*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出候选独立块因果注意力机制，消除决策模型对候选序列化顺序的依赖，同时保持决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准因果交叉编码会使候选动作的得分依赖于序列化顺序，而非底层决策问题，这对生成系统中的System 1组件尤为不利，因为候选的提出或排序在不同运行中可能不同。

Method: 引入候选独立块因果注意力：在共享上下文和每个候选内部保留因果计算，但阻断候选间的信息流，并重置候选位置。在Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B和Qwen3 4B骨干上，与标准因果注意力和互补的不变性基线进行比较，并进行消融实验。

Result: 候选独立注意力持续降低排列敏感性，同时保持有竞争力的决策质量；消融表明候选隔离是效果的主要来源，位置重置补全了预期的对称性。在Qwen3-4B上使用更多训练数据的进一步研究验证了该架构的行为。

Conclusion: 候选独立块因果注意力能有效提升决策模型对候选排列的不变性，且不牺牲决策质量，代码和模型已公开。

Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [451] [Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01633)
*Sahel Torkamani,Henry Gouk,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文引入基于度量幅度理论的“幅度势”，用于刻画任意点由给定集合表示的程度，并以此分析神经网络泛化与训练动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络泛化与训练动态仍缺乏统一解释，现有方法多针对不同现象分别研究，需要一种能同时揭示表示、记忆与结构变化的几何量。

Method: 定义幅度势，在logit层计算某点相对单个类与整个数据集的幅度势比值；将单点比值与Feldman记忆分数关联，并聚合各点比值以检测决策边界结构变化，在模块算术任务中分析grokking，同时与神经坍缩进行比较及抑制实验。

Result: 单点幅度势比值与Feldman记忆分数相关；聚合比值能检测决策边界结构变化并作为grokking的几何指标；即使显式抑制神经坍缩，幅度势比值仍具信息性。

Conclusion: 幅度势比值是一种有效的几何指标，可统一考察神经泛化中的记忆、决策边界变化与grokking，且其信息不依赖于神经坍缩。

Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

</details>


### [452] [FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01638)
*Wentao Yue,Tianyou Lai,Hongji Li,Qingyu Mao,Qilei Li*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: FedSAP：一种面向异构联邦学习的域感知结构化剪枝框架，通过三态通道分配与类型匹配聚合，在客户端资源与数据分布异构下提升全局精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资源自适应方法只决定客户端训练模型的比例，未考虑保留容量应位于何处及如何共享；联邦域泛化方法通常假设共享完整架构。统一压缩会丢弃高价值通道，单一聚合路径会混合可迁移特征与域敏感更新。

Method: 将结构化剪枝建模为预算约束的三态通道分配：把各保留率转换为非均匀层预算，将稳定通道分入Global池、有用的域敏感通道分入伪域专属Private池、低效用通道置为Dropped状态；通过Domain-Guided Assignment从浅层梯度相似度推断伪域，并用Type-Matched Aggregation限制每个通道的共享范围。

Result: 在三个随机种子上，Digits与Office-Caltech平均全局精度分别达76.00%和72.67%，比最强基线高1.70和4.92个百分点，并支持异构客户端最高80%的剪枝率。

Conclusion: FedSAP有效兼顾资源预算不均与域偏移，通过通道级差异化共享在支持高压缩率的同时提升异构联邦学习的全局性能。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) on heterogeneous edge devices must jointly accommodate unequal resource budgets and domain-shifted local data. Existing resource-adaptive methods decide how much of a model each client trains but not where retained capacity should reside or how it should be shared, whereas federated domain-generalization methods usually assume a shared full architecture. Uniform compression can therefore discard high-utility channels, and a single aggregation path can mix transferable features with domain-sensitive updates. We propose FedSAP, a domain-aware heterogeneous FL framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation. FedSAP converts each keep ratio into non-uniform layer budgets, assigns stable channels to a Global pool, useful domain-sensitive channels to pseudo-domain-specific Private pools, and low-utility channels to a Dropped state. This partition lets broadly useful features benefit from cross-client pooling while isolating domain-sensitive updates from incompatible clients. Domain-Guided Assignment infers pseudo-domains from shallow-gradient similarity, while Type-Matched Aggregation restricts each channel to its intended sharing scope. Across three random seeds, FedSAP reaches 76.00% and 72.67% mean global accuracy on Digits and Office-Caltech, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.70 and 4.92 percentage points while supporting client pruning ratios of up to 80% across heterogeneous clients.

</details>


### [453] [Beyond Demographic Balance: Multi-Metric and Intersectional Evaluation of Fairness in MIMIC-IV Mortality Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01645)
*Abdullah Al Noman,Fahmid Al Rifat,Tahrima Hashem,Syed Muhammad Ibne Zulfiker,Rishov Paul,Tanzima HAshem*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究重新审视ICU死亡率预测中的公平性评估选择，比较多种公平性干预在预测效用与亚组误差指标下的表现，并引入一种不依赖死亡结局的轻量适应策略以平衡种族-性别-保险的表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床预测中的公平性结论可能强烈依赖于所报告的评估指标以及评估性能时的人口统计分辨率，因此需要系统比较不同指标和亚组层级下干预措施的评价差异。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV上针对ICU死亡率预测，比较预测效用指标与亚组误差指标；引入一种轻量适应策略，联合平衡种族-性别-保险表示而不以死亡结局为条件；在边际和对应的三向交叉亚组层面评估其行为，并考虑细粒度估计的统计支持。

Result: 干预措施在准确率/AUROC、敏感性和假阳性率下可能得到显著不同的评估；边际人口统计摘要可能掩盖其组成交叉亚组内的异质性误差分布，包括较大亚组中的异质性。

Conclusion: 评估公平性干预时需同时考虑互补的指标和亚组分辨率，并兼顾干预目标及亚组估计的可靠性。

Abstract: Fairness conclusions in clinical prediction can depend strongly on both the metrics reported and the demographic resolution at which performance is evaluated. We revisit these evaluation choices for ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV, comparing predictive-utility and subgroup-error metrics across several fairness interventions. As a complementary case study, we introduce a lightweight adaptation strategy that jointly balances ethnicity--gender--insurance representation without conditioning on mortality outcomes, allowing demographic representation balancing to be examined separately from outcome-conditioned or direct error-rate interventions. We evaluate its behavior at both marginal and corresponding three-way intersectional subgroup levels, while accounting for the statistical support of finer-grained estimates. The results show that interventions can receive substantially different assessments across accuracy/AUROC, sensitivity, and false-positive rate, and that marginal demographic summaries can conceal heterogeneous error profiles within their constituent intersections, including among larger subgroups. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating fairness interventions at both complementary metric and subgroup resolutions, while accounting for the intervention target and the reliability of subgroup estimates.

</details>


### [454] [Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01674)
*Shivalika Singh,Andrija Djurisic,Gbemileke Onilude,Sudip Roy,Sara Hooker*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 Invent-A-Dataset 基于提示的系统，在零数据条件下生成大规模后训练数据集，并在八类任务上显著优于五种前沿模型 API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 开发中构建数据集高度依赖人工且脆弱，而实际应用中常面临无任何目标能力数据的零数据场景。

Method: Invent-A-Dataset 采用基于提示的流程，从数据集的描述直接生成真实、大规模的后训练数据集；与 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai 五种前沿模型 API 在八种任务类型、最多 20K 样本规模下进行对比评估。

Result: 生成质量相对提升 17%，多样性相对提升 19%；多样性优势随数据集规模增大而扩大（200 样本时持平，20K 样本时相对提升 37%）；下游训练获得显著性能增益，微调模型在不同架构上排名更高。

Conclusion: Invent-A-Dataset 能在零数据条件下高效生成高质量、高多样性的后训练数据，并带来持续且可扩展的下游训练收益。

Abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). Its diversity advantage widens with scale of training dataset size (from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples). This translates into considerable downstream training gains, resulting in far more performant post-trained models. Invent-A-Dataset fine-tune consistently ranks higher compared to other generator fine-tunes across different post-trained model architectures.

</details>


### [455] [Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01692)
*Haochen Chai,Xinbi Luo,Zining Liu,Fangfang Jiang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究探究了归一化统计量来源对腕部皮肤电活动情感识别模型预训练收益的影响，发现使用保留用户自身记录统计量会显著降低预训练增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情感识别模型在评估时很少报告归一化统计量的来源，而使用保留用户自身记录的统计量相当于提供了设备初次佩戴时无法获得的信息，可能导致预训练收益被高估。

Method: 预训练紧凑卷积网络SAFE-EDA（基于43名被试的专家伪迹标注），在WESAD数据集（15名被试，留一被试交叉验证）上从零训练进行对比；交叉两种归一化来源（仅训练被试 vs. 保留用户完整记录）与四种窗口跳跃，并在第二个数据集（26名被试）上验证13种配置。

Result: 仅使用训练被试统计量时，预训练将macro-F1提升0.078至0.227；使用保留用户完整记录统计量时，增益降至0.020至0.050且不显著。伪迹监督预训练（0.078）远优于自监督预训练（0.008）。13种配置中12种预训练网络更优，但第二个数据集上按用户归一化反而增大增益，表明交互作用依赖数据。50篇已发表WESAD研究中仅5篇说明了归一化所用数据。

Conclusion: 报告归一化统计量来源对于区分设备初次使用性能与校准后性能至关重要，否则预训练收益可能被高估。

Abstract: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. When the statistics came only from training subjects, pretraining raised macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227; when they came from the held-out user's full recording, the gain fell to between 0.020 and 0.050 and was no longer significant. Artifact supervision was far more useful than self-supervised pretraining on the same recordings (0.078 versus 0.008). Across 13 configurations in two datasets, the pretrained network was better in 12, but on the second dataset (26 subjects) per-user normalization increased the gain instead of reducing it, so the interaction depends on the data. Only five of 50 published WESAD studies state which data were used for normalization. Reporting this choice is necessary to separate first-use performance from performance after calibration.

</details>


### [456] [RelICL: Training-free Relational Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01725)
*Simon Forbat,Rainer Gemulla*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文指出深度特征合成（DFS）在关系学习中存在特征爆炸和交互盲区两个问题，提出RelICL方法，通过在图模式上逐步传播和融合信息来缓解这些问题，并在RelBench任务上取得与最强DFS方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在单表任务上无需训练即可达到最优性能，近期研究通过DFS将关系模式展平为单表以适配关系学习，但DFS存在特征爆炸（特征数量随模式复杂度快速增长）和交互盲区（列聚合忽略特征交互）两个关键问题。

Method: 提出RelICL方法，其核心是使用最终用于预测的同一表格基础模型，在模式图上逐步传播和融合信息，从而保留DFS优势的同时缓解特征爆炸和交互盲区问题。

Result: 在RelBench任务的实验研究中，RelICL与基于深度特征合成的最强方法性能相当。

Conclusion: RelICL为关系学习提供了一种替代DFS的有效方法，在保持性能的同时缓解了DFS的两个关键问题。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance on single-table tasks without any training. Recent work suggests that they are also well-suited for relational learning via deep feature synthesis (DFS), which flattens a relational schema into a single table by adding aggregates of the other tables' columns as features. This approach is appealing because it directly benefits from improvements to or customization of the underlying tabular foundation model. In this paper, we identify two key problems with DFS: feature explosion and interaction blindness. The first problem arises because the number of DFS features grows quickly as the schema becomes more complex, limiting scalability and performance. The second problem arises because column-wise aggregates do not account for feature interactions, limiting performance. We propose and explore an alternative method termed RelICL, which keeps the benefits of DFS but alleviates these two problems. At its heart, RelICL propagates and fuses information step by step through the schema graph, using the same tabular foundation model that is eventually used for prediction to do so. In our experimental study using RelBench tasks, RelICL was on par with the strongest approach based on deep feature synthesis.

</details>


### [457] [Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01728)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann,Moritz Grillo,Andrei Balakin,Georg Loho*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文研究了无偏置浅层ReLU网络在高斯总体损失下的教师-学生设置，发现学习到的线性跳跃连接能消除虚假局部极小值，并揭示了学生网络特征学习的有效宽度受教师宽度控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解损失景观对解释神经网络训练至关重要，但即使在简单模型中其结构也仅被部分理解。本文旨在通过教师-学生设置下的浅层ReLU网络，研究特征学习和过参数化等关键方面。

Method: 分析无偏置浅层ReLU网络在高斯总体损失下的教师-学生设置。针对具有正输出权重和平面特征的教师网络，研究学习线性跳跃连接对虚假局部极小值的影响；并分析学生网络在非负输出权重下局部极小点的特征方向。

Result: 当学生网络至少与教师网络同宽时，加入学习线性跳跃可消除所有非负学生输出权重的虚假局部极小值；无跳跃时，构造的固定教师网络（输入维度2，仅3个隐藏神经元）的虚假局部极小值在任意学生宽度（至少3）下持续存在。正输出权重学生网络总能学习教师特征张成的子空间；二维ReLU网络中，即使高度过参数化，学生网络的有效宽度受教师宽度控制，每个正输出权重的临界点最多有教师神经元两倍的不同学生特征方向。最后，将良性结果转移到任意指定半径参数球上的经验极小值，所需采样精度取决于该半径。

Conclusion: 学习线性跳跃连接能消除任意过参数化下持续存在的虚假极小值；学生网络在局部极小点学习教师特征子空间，且有效宽度受教师宽度限制；良性结果可推广到参数球上的经验极小值。

Abstract: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.

</details>


### [458] [Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01739)
*Jiajun He,Denis Blessing,Mouyang Cheng,Yuanqi Du,Carles Domingo-Enrich*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出离散吉布斯迭代神经采样器，解决现有离散神经采样器模式崩溃、无收敛保证及依赖特定参考过程的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从离散、未归一化分布中采样且无数据访问是难题；现有神经采样器易模式崩溃，固定点迭代训练无收敛保证，且常绑定特定参考过程（如掩码或均匀扩散）。

Method: 基于掩码扩散构建固定点神经采样器，可扩展到分布对间的传输，实现高效可扩展学习。

Result: 显著减少模式崩溃，有效扩展到高维系统，支持跨不同条件的摊销采样，并能准确估计合金相图。

Conclusion: 该框架克服了现有离散神经采样器的局限，为高维采样和相图估计提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. We demonstrate that the resulting method scales effectively to high-dimensional systems, supports amortized sampling across different conditions, and enables accurate estimation of alloy phase diagrams.

</details>


### [459] [Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01751)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出证据门控研究（EGR）统计采纳层，解决自适应模型搜索路径依赖导致的假发现率失控问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应模型搜索具有路径依赖性：已采纳的挑战者成为后续候选生成的参照，统计上无支持的替换会改变尚未提出的假设，需在模型替换点进行统计控制。

Method: EGR在决策证据揭示前冻结挑战者，在预声明环境集上构建随时有效证据，可预测地路由证据至未解决组件，组合持久候选e值并传递给在线控制器；在条件有效性和可预测性条件下控制全环境采纳目标的FDR。

Result: 5000条轨迹闭环基准中，仅开发集e-LOND持续FDR达0.621，而审计的EGR变体未观察到持续假采纳路径；600对挑战者-现任者匹配重放中，Stagewise EGR保持固定随时备择交叉决策，代表性阈值下减少56.1%决策证据；三环境公共数据研究和40000样本受控神经基准复现证据效率模式。

Conclusion: 模型替换是自适应模型开发中一个独立的统计控制点。

Abstract: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.621, whereas no persistent false-adoption path is observed for the audited EGR variants in that finite run. In matched replay over 600 challenger--incumbent pairs, Stagewise EGR preserves fixed-anytime alternative crossing decisions while using 56.1% less decision evidence at the representative threshold. A three-environment public-data study and a 40,000-sample controlled neural benchmark reproduce the evidence-efficiency pattern. These results identify model replacement as a distinct statistical control point in adaptive model development.

</details>


### [460] [Debias Anything: Fairness with Diversity without Supervision in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01815)
*Théau d'Audiffret,Mariia Vladimirova,Jean-Yves Franceschi*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出一种无需敏感属性标注的适配器方法，将冻结扩散模型连接到预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间，联合引导公平性与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型会复制并放大训练数据中的人口统计学不平衡；现有去偏方法依赖分类器引导或显式文本条件，降低适用性和输出多样性；仅促进多样性的方法又不能保证公平的属性表示。

Method: 训练一个适配器，将冻结扩散模型接入预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间；利用成对文本提示定义属性方向，将批次组成导向特定比例以实现公平性；引入基于该表示语义估计之间分歧的分数来促进多样性；无需敏感属性标注、先验知识或数据，支持无条件与文本条件扩散模型。

Result: 实验确认该方法在可比的公平性水平下提升了图像质量分数和多样性分数。

Conclusion: 该方法可普遍适用于任意扩散模型和任意敏感属性，在不牺牲多样性且无需敏感属性标注的情况下实现公平性引导。

Abstract: Although diffusion models produce high-quality images, they also reproduce and amplify demographic imbalances in their training data. Debiasing their generation process post-training w.r.t. some sensitive attribute usually relies on classifier guidance or explicit text extra-conditioning, but this reduces methods' applicability and output diversity. Conversely, methods promoting diversity alone do not ensure fair attribute representation. In this paper, we propose a method tackling fairness and diversity jointly that is generally applicable to any diffusion model and any sensitive attribute. To this end, an adapter connects the frozen diffusion model to a pretrained vision-language embedding space, enabling fairness and diversity guidance without sensitive-attribute annotations. For fairness, pairs of text prompts define attribute directions which guide batch composition towards specific proportions. For diversity, we introduce a score measuring disagreement between the semantic estimates derived from this representation. The formulation supports unconditional and text-conditional diffusion models, while requiring no prior knowledge or data of sensitive attribute. Experiments confirm that our method improves quality and diversity scores at comparable fairness levels.

</details>


### [461] [Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01821)
*Tido Specht,Elias Benedict Krey,Nils Neukirch,Nils Strodthoff*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文将非线性多维概念发现方法适配到LLM的token级激活，提出基于概念的比对分数（CBA），揭示了LLM内部概念流形的分层几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机械可解释性方法受限于强线性假设，无法刻画LLM中非线性特征流形，因此需要超越线性概念，以低维流形建模内部token表示。

Method: 将计算机视觉中的非线性多维概念发现（NLMCD）适配到LLM token级激活，把概念建模为低维流形；提出CBA分数（广义Rand指数），用于跨层、跨模型比较概念流形的几何邻近性，无需显式特征匹配。

Result: 六项发现：(i) 相邻层 sanity check 显示CBA比PCA或CKA线性基线更敏感；(ii) 逐层比对矩阵在中间层和后期层呈现两个块结构，且跨模型一致，被线性指标掩盖；(iii) 概念组成在网络大部分层由语法主导，后期层转向语法-语义混合概念，并逐渐输出导向；(iv) 英汉多语言概念共享依赖训练，Qwen最强、Llama较弱、GPT-2缺失；(v) 跨模型比对反映相同结构，同族不同规模Qwen对应强，跨模型族弱；(vi) Tulu-3训练各阶段中相邻阶段对齐最高，base到SFT变化最大，后续偏好对齐阶段（DPO、RLVR）基本不改变早期层，RLVR大多保留DPO后期层概念。

Conclusion: 非线性概念流形视角能揭示线性方法无法发现的分层与跨模型结构，概念共享和训练阶段影响均具有条件依赖性，为LLM内部表示分析提供了更敏感、更几何化的工具。

Abstract: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

</details>


### [462] [Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01827)
*Kevin Tirta Wijaya,Alston Lo,Michael Sun,Wojciech Matusik,Vahid Babaei*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出PRISMS框架，利用多保真度专家的成对排序信号进行候选筛选，减少对绝对分数回归模型的依赖，并在药物发现和优化任务中提升效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算可大规模生成候选分子/材料/设计，但实验验证能力有限，形成验证拥堵；现有筛选依赖数据驱动的绝对分数回归模型，需要大量实验数据，而科学设计发现本质上是比较性的。

Method: PRISMS使用一个或多个专家（计算工具或人类，不同保真度）提供的成对排序来识别最有希望的候选，避免数据饥渴的回归器；当专家保真度和成本不同时，基于Fisher信息准则将成对查询从低保真度升级到高保真度排序器。

Result: 在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，PRISMS达到50% top-10发现召回率所需轮数比仅回归的主动学习少约42%，比无选择性升级的基于排序方法少约15%；在无预定义库的新设计优化中，超体积比贝叶斯优化基线高约18.8%。

Conclusion: PRISMS表明，主要依靠专家成对排序（而非绝对分数回归）进行筛选是可行且高效的，多保真度选择性升级能进一步加速科学设计发现。

Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.

</details>


### [463] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出OMAF框架，将Transformer流策略与一步动作生成结合，实现高效在线多智能体强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习需兼顾多模态动作分布的表达能力与训练执行效率，扩散策略采样慢，难以在线扩展。

Method: 采用基于Transformer的流策略建模复杂协调行为，使用近似路径分数代理实现同步流策略优化，并设计软max Q值估计与联合流策略目标的联合优化方案，消除迭代采样。

Result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个标准任务上，OMAF持续取得更优性能，回报最高提升3.4倍，样本效率最高提升10.5倍。

Conclusion: OMAF验证了一步流策略范式可作为在线多智能体强化学习中兼具表达力与计算效率的有效方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

</details>


### [464] [A foundation for systematic analysis of transformers and RNNs for tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01894)
*Emmanuelle Renauld,Philippe Poulin,Hugo Larochelle,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 系统评估RNN和Transformer在扩散MRI纤维束成像中的迭代应用，通过生成-验证阶段实现流线级监督，在ISMRM2015数据集上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散MRI纤维束成像中局部扩散信息与全局解剖合理性之间存在固有矛盾，机器学习方法有潜力解决该问题。

Method: 评估RNN和Transformer用于迭代纤维束成像，关注训练策略、输入表示（CNN嵌入和EOS标记）及超参数选择；引入生成-验证阶段在训练中实现流线级监督；使用ISMRM2015数据集进行受控实验，量化缺失束、噪声或非完美训练流线及无效纤维的影响；并在Tractoinferno数据库的活体数据上验证最佳模型。

Result: 在ISMRM2015纤维束成像挑战数据集上达到迄今为止最高性能；量化了训练集中缺失束、噪声流线和无效纤维的影响；最佳模型成功应用于Tractoinferno活体数据。

Conclusion: 序列基深度学习模型（如Transformer和RNN）在纤维束成像中既有潜力也有局限，需要改进体模和评估方法以进行活体验证；为未来研究人员训练和验证序列基监督方法提供建议。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising approach for improving diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography, a task that remains limited by the intrinsic tension between local diffusion information and global anatomical plausibility. In this work, we systematically evaluate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and Transformer models for iterative tractography, with particular attention to training strategies, input representations (including convolutional neural network (CNN)-based embeddings and end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens), and hyperparameter selection. We introduce a generation-validation phase enabling supervision at the streamline level during training, allowing supervision despite the mismatch between local loss functions and global streamline quality. Using the ISMRM2015 tractography challenge dataset, our models achieve the highest reported performance to date. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the impact of missing bundles, noisy or imperfect training streamlines, and invalid fibers in the training set. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of our best-performing models for in vivo data from the Tractoinferno database. Overall, our results highlight both the potential and the limits of sequence-based deep learning models such as Transformers and RNNs for tractography, and emphasize the need for improved phantoms and evaluation methods for in vivo validation. We provide takeaways and recommendations for future researchers training and validating sequence-based supervised methods for tractography.

</details>


### [465] [Same Reward, Different Skills: When Multimodal RL Learns to Look](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01908)
*Haocun Ye,Xinlong Jiang,Qile Chen,Bingyu Wang,Teng Zhang,Shubai Chen,Tingyu Wu,Zhenkun Zheng,Yiqiang Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文指出RLVR中图像未进入学习信号的问题，提出视觉可解性设计原则，并在反事实坐标场景中证明仅靠文本奖励无法学会视觉定位，唯有要求视觉证据的奖励才能提升发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR虽能提升视觉语言基准分数，但训练时即使无视觉信息也能获得增益，说明提示中的图像并非学习信号中的图像，需要设计让视觉证据成为正确回答必要条件的任务。

Method: 提出视觉可解性设计规则：视觉证据对正确答案必要且任务可学习。在反事实坐标场景中，问题固定且目标不被命名，正确答案需在图像中定位目标；使用标准GRPO和正确性加格式奖励训练7B模型，并设置灰色画布替换测试图像、灰色画布训练等控制实验。

Result: 7B模型在比训练集更密集的留出场景中，目标发现准确率从0.425提升至0.875，并泛化到未训练的问题类型。测试时用灰色画布替换图像，发现准确率降为零；训练时用灰色画布，即使在匹配步数30和四个随机种子下，增益几乎为零。学习到的技能可迁移到独立构建的定位任务。在相同图像、奖励和预算下，添加回答训练问题的标题会使增益减少近三分之二。

Conclusion: 改变奖励所要求的内容会改变RL学习到的内容；只有奖励要求视觉证据时，模型才能学会真正的视觉定位技能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language benchmark scores even without visual information during training. With images at test, blind-trained models recover roughly half of the real-image gain at 3B and nearly four fifths at 7B. Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. Our design rule, visual resolvability, asks that visual evidence be necessary for a correct answer and that the task remain learnable. We test it on counterfactual coordinate scenes in which the question stays fixed and the target is never named, so a correct answer requires finding the target in the image. With standard GRPO and correctness-and-format rewards, a 7B model raises its accuracy at finding the target (discovery) from 0.425 to 0.875 on held-out scenes denser than any it trained on, and it improves on question types it never trained on. Two controls locate the source of the gain. Replacing test images with gray canvases drops discovery to zero; training on gray canvases instead, at matched step 30 and in each of four seeds, yields essentially none of the gain even when the model is then tested with real images. The learned skill carries over to grounding tasks built independently of the training corpus. A caption that answers the training question, added to the same images, reward and budget, cuts the gain by nearly two thirds. Changing what reward requires changes what RL learns.

</details>


### [466] [Learning to Predict Distributions over Weight Updates for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01934)
*Azal Ahmad Khan,Keshav Ramji,Tahira Naseem,Ali Anwar,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文研究仅基于输入查询的查询条件超网络用于LoRA估计，并提出分布超网络生成LoRA分布，实现测试时权重采样缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索仅使用输入查询作为适应信号时，超网络能获取多少适应信息，并研究分布超网络在LLM适应中的潜力。

Method: 研究查询条件超网络估计LoRA参数，提出分布超网络生成LoRA分布，采用可微蒙特卡洛近似的端到端损失，探索回归和凸组合等分布参数化。

Result: 学习分布的均值可超越确定性超网络；采样权重更新实现测试时缩放，性能随权重样本增加而提升，优于token采样基线；生成的更新可跨查询迁移。

Conclusion: 查询条件权重更新分布可同时支持模型适应和测试时缩放。

Abstract: Hypernetworks have recently shown success in dynamically adapting the parameters of Large Language Models (LLMs) at runtime based on signals such as task descriptions or additional demostrations. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a distribution over possible LoRAs. For this we propose a simple end-to-end loss using a differentiable Monte Carlo approximation and explore multiple distribution parametrizations including regression and convex combination variants. Results show that even using the mean of the learned distribution can outperform deterministic hypernetworks. Crucially, the learned distribution enables a different form of test-time scaling: instead of spending additional compute only by sampling more token sequences from a fixed model, we sample weight updates, yielding multiple adapted models for the same query. Performance improves as more weight samples are considered and remains stronger than corresponding token-sampling adaptation baselines. Finally, we find that generated updates can transfer across queries, suggesting that the hypernetwork learns reusable structure in how the model should adapt. Together, these results show that query-conditioned distributions over weight updates can support both adaptation and test-time scaling.

</details>


### [467] [FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198)
*Sebastian Sanokowski,Alireza Sarmadi,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出FERPO，一种基于前向KL与自归一化重要性采样的最大熵在线强化学习算法，避免对critic求动作梯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续控制在线RL依赖critic的动作梯度更新策略，但critic训练目标是预测回报，价值预测准确并不保证动作导数准确，导致策略更新不可靠。

Method: 从熵与KL散度正则化的策略改进目标推导最优目标动作分布；用自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）以rollout策略采样的动作估计前向KL目标并拟合actor；通过KL正则限制目标分布与rollout策略的偏离以稳定重要性权重；前向KL鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态。

Result: 在MuJoCo Playground与ManiSkill上取得有竞争力的性能与样本效率提升，消融实验验证各组件；计算基准显示actor更新快于REPPO。

Conclusion: FERPO无需对critic求动作梯度即可完成策略改进，前向KL目标促进多模态覆盖与探索，性能与效率优于基线。

Abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

</details>


### [468] [FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01967)
*Tianshuo Qiao,Naiqian Zheng,Xiaopeng Liu,Shuguang Wang,Diandian Gu,Xuanzhe Liu,Xin Jin*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: FastCI通过运行时证据选择受影响测试、剪枝等价上下文测试、优先高风险测试并优化测试负载，降低LLM训练框架CI延迟和GPU资源使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM训练框架的CI依赖GPU密集型测试，导致CI成为快速开发的瓶颈。

Method: FastCI利用运行时证据选择受影响测试，剪枝在等价上下文中执行变更代码的测试，按风险优先暴露失败，并沿测试预期验证范围外的维度优化测试负载。

Result: 在LLM训练框架CI工作负载上，与当前部署的CI流水线相比，FastCI将CI延迟降低77.5%，GPU资源使用降低63.9%，同时将修改代码覆盖率保留率提高3.2%。

Conclusion: FastCI已集成到字节跳动LLM训练框架的CI流水线中，有效提升CI效率。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity, their training frameworks evolve at a rapid pace as well. Therefore, continuous integration (CI) is critical for maintaining the quality and stability of these frameworks. However, unlike traditional software, CI for LLM training frameworks relies on GPU-intensive tests, which usually involve complete model training or evaluation. This leads CI itself to become a new bottleneck for fast-paced development. In this paper, we introduce FastCI, a framework that improves the efficiency of CI for LLM training frameworks. FastCI leverages runtime evidence to select affected tests and prune tests that execute changed code in equivalent contexts. Then FastCI prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and optimizes test workloads along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9%, while improving the modified code coverage retention by 3.2%, compared with the currently deployed CI pipelines. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance.

</details>


### [469] [Sim+Real: Joint Simulation - Experiment Training Improves Balanced Prediction in Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01974)
*Mahindra Rautela,Alexander Scheinker,Ayan Biswas,Diane Oyen,Nathan DeBardeleben,Earl Lawrence*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 将仿真-实验预测建模为多目标学习问题，比较四种训练策略在流体系统上的域内与跨域表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准仿真到实验的微调仅优化实验目标，迁移后会损害仿真性能，需要兼顾两个域的风险。

Method: 在RealPDEBench的四个流体系统和两种模型容量上，对比Simulation only、Experiment only、Sim→Exp和Joint训练，并在两个留出域上评估最终模型。

Result: Sim→Exp更偏向实验数据但导致仿真域遗忘；Joint在广泛的仿真-实验评估权重下取得最佳平衡，显著优于Sim→Exp的仿真保持，并能更好保留实验中缺失的纯仿真场。

Conclusion: 联合训练是兼顾仿真与实验性能的更优策略，可缓解微调带来的仿真域遗忘问题。

Abstract: Simulation and experimental measurements provide complementary data for learning spatiotemporal physical systems, but standard simulation-to-experiment fine-tuning optimizes only the experimental objective after transfer and can degrade simulation performance. We formulate simulation--experiment prediction as a multi-objective learning problem with domain-specific simulation and experimental risks. On four fluid systems from RealPDEBench and two model capacities, we compare Simulation only, Experiment only, Sim$\rightarrow$Exp, and Joint training, evaluating every final model on both held-out domains. Sim$\rightarrow$Exp tends to specialize more strongly to experimental data at the cost of simulation-domain forgetting. Joint training consistently achieves the best balanced performance over a broad range of simulation--experiment evaluation weightings, while substantially improving simulation retention over Sim$\rightarrow$Exp. Joint also better preserves simulation-only fields absent from experimental measurements. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph.

</details>


### [470] [The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01980)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文揭示了线性优化决策聚焦学习中不连续优化器的平滑行为，推导出闭式曲率并给出近似方法，最终应用于场景生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性优化中的决策聚焦学习因优化器的不连续性而复杂化，小的成本误差可能导致决策不变或跳到不同顶点。

Method: 证明数据分布平均后非光滑逐点行为变为局部二次，推导出支撑在正常扇形壁上的矩阵值测度形式的闭式曲率；提出仅需一次投影到可行集的可处理近似，并证明其弱收敛于真实总体曲率。

Result: 实验验证了二次与弱收敛规律；在电池套利任务中，相比均匀分配，遗憾改进达30.8%。

Conclusion: 该曲率分析为决策感知场景生成提供了理论基础，并在实际应用中显著优于基线方法。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

</details>


### [471] [Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02012)
*Tristan Shah,Wooyoung Chung,Volodomyr Makarenko,Juan Wachs,Stas Tiomkin*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出F-CIP目标，一种无需领域知识选择信息变量的无监督强化学习方法，通过系统动力学自身定义内在奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统强化学习依赖人工设计奖励信号，现有无监督强化学习的内在动机目标仍需选择信息变量，重新引入了领域专家知识，违背了减少工程干预的初衷。

Method: 将可控信息生产（CIP）目标重新表述为强化学习原生的前向CIP（F-CIP），该目标仅由系统动力学定义，无需选择信息变量；证明其与强化学习兼容，并在现有算法中实现。

Result: 训练智能体可无监督发现平衡、保持可控性等基本行为；结合简单的前向速度奖励，能产生跳跃、奔跑等协调步态，而传统方法需奖励工程才能学习。

Conclusion: F-CIP消除了内在动机目标中对信息变量的选择需求，有效实现无监督行为发现，并能与简单任务奖励结合产生复杂机器人行为。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. Training agents with F-CIP results in unsupervised discovery of primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability, which are essential for more complex robot behaviors. Paired with a simple forward-velocity reward, our method produces coordinated gaits such as hopping and running which otherwise require reward engineering to learn.

</details>


### [472] [When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02159)
*Scott W. Viteri,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Clark Barrett*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于反事实信息的探索准则，并证明现有内在奖励在特定环境下无法实现最优探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内在奖励（如预测误差、学习进度）虽能引导探索，但最大化这些奖励并不一定产生最具信息量的经验。

Method: 形式化定义探索准则：比较策略所获取的反事实信息，即历史在替代策略下替代经验的能力；构建单一简单环境，分析计数、预测误差、赋权、信息增益等目标的最大化策略。

Result: 在该环境中，上述内在奖励的最大化策略在获取反事实信息上是帕累托次优的；解释了失败原因，并给出使现有内在奖励成功鼓励最优探索的条件。

Conclusion: 现有内在奖励存在局限，并构造了一个新目标：当探索按该准则严格改进时赋予更高价值。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

</details>


### [473] [Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02189)
*Jason X. Liu,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Soojung Yang,Xinyu A. Feng,Abigail Park,Anagha Aneesh,Lacramioara Bintu,Alexander R. Dunn,Grant M. Rotskoff*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出IDiom模型和RL-SAE方法，用于内在无序蛋白区域（IDR）的可控设计，通过显式控制功能相关序列特征实现可解释、可组合的IDR设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IDR在转录调控、信号转导和亚细胞定位等细胞过程中起核心作用，但基于结构的设计方法不适用于IDR，且现有蛋白质语言模型在全长序列上训练，偏向折叠结构域，难以有效设计IDR。

Method: 构建IDiom-DB数据集（来自AlphaFold数据库的5400万条预测IDR），训练自回归蛋白质语言模型IDiom；提出RL-SAE后训练方法，利用稀疏自编码器特征进行强化学习，奖励激活指定特征集的序列生成。

Result: 在8个IDR设计任务中，RL-SAE生成的序列平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而激活引导仅24%；相比引导和监督微调，RL-SAE提升了生成IDR的预测亚细胞定位和转录活性，并能将不同生物功能的特征组合在单个序列中。

Conclusion: IDiom和RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现了可解释且可组合的IDR设计，RL-SAE可扩展至其他需要可解释特征作为设计目标的蛋白质设计场景。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

</details>


### [474] [Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02190)
*Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: ZFO 框架将方向选择与步长解耦，利用零阶评估沿一维子空间选择曲率感知步长，提升大规模神经网络优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模神经网络优化中，步长选择是关键挑战：保守步长收敛慢，激进步长不稳定。

Method: 结合零阶与一阶优化（ZFO），使用可信一阶优化器确定方向，仅沿该一维子空间进行零阶评估，利用当前梯度信息和两次额外目标函数评估构建局部模型，在有限搜索区间内选择曲率感知步长。

Result: 理论保证共享样本评估产生可靠有限差分曲率估计，局部模型选择近最优步长，ZFO 收敛到稳定点邻域；在语言模型和数据集上，ZFO 常优于固定步长一阶基线，提升幅度和首选局部模型取决于目标。

Conclusion: ZFO 提供了一种轻量级自适应步长选择机制，计算成本低于完整线搜索，能有效改善优化和最终性能。

Abstract: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how far to move. Using the current {gradient information} and two additional objective function evaluations, ZFO instances construct a local model of the objective function along the proposed direction and select a curvature-aware step within a bounded search interval. This yields an adaptive step-selection mechanism that costs less than a full line search. We provide theoretical guarantees to show that shared-sample evaluations produce reliable finite-difference curvature estimates, that the induced local model selects a near-optimal step along the search interval, and that ZFO converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point. Across the evaluated settings, language models and datasets, ZFO frequently improves optimization and final performance relative to fixed-step first-order baselines, with the magnitude and preferred local model depending on the objective. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework.

</details>
